nat cachone.name: Nat Cachone
nat cachone.origin: "Legs" Cachone was a mob leader who was wanted for a plethora of crimes in the city of Chicago. Deciding that there was too much heat in the United States, he and his mob would relocate to South America to capitalize on the weaker law enforcement. There they would take over the Columbian Mining Company, forcing locals to mine its gold for them. Unaccustomed to living in the wilds of South America, Legs would contract sleeping sickness. In order to cure their boss, his gang would trick sleeping disease specialist Dr. Smythe to journey to South America under the pretension that the entire supposedly legit mining camp was afflicted by the disease. Accompanying Dr. Smythe was his daughter Joan, who was previously warned by the extra dimensional hero the Vision that they were in danger. Not heeding his warning in time, Dr. Smythe would journey to the camp and by this point could not shirk his duty as a health care professional by letting a man suffer, even a criminal like Cachone. In return Cachone would allow Smythe to leave the camp, but his daughter had to stay behind in order to prevent him from alerting the American authorities as to where he was hiding out. Smythe would refuse, and when Joan slapped Legs across the face he would punish her by dangling her over an alligator pit. When Smythe tried to rescue his daughter, Legs would push him down and put a lit match under the hell of his shoe to watch him burn. But the smoke from the match would allow the Vision to appear. As the Vision fought off Leg's men, Cachone would cut Joan loose leaving her to the gator. While the Vision came to her rescue, Cachone would take Smythe up to the top of a mountain and threaten to throw him down to the river below. This would be Leg's undoing, as the ledge they were standing on crumbled under the combined weight of the two men. The Vision would swoop down and only rescue Smythe, leaving Cochone to fall to his death.

nat scott.name: Nat Scott
nat scott.origin: Death Head Scott was a criminal wanted by the FBI for unspecified crimes in the 1940s. By 1945 he developed a means of transmitting lethal electrical jolts through the air into copper discs to eliminate his enemies. With this technology, he then mailed copper discs to the FBI agents who were actively seeking to capture him. One such agent was friends with the Whizzer who realized what the discs were capable of and dropped it on the ground before a lethal jolt could shock either of them. Following the current back to Death Head Scott's hideout, the Whizzer attempted to capture the villain, but Scott released a trap door trapping the Whizzer in a room that spun so fast that it kept the hero pinned to the wall. The Whizzer managed to break free then disposed of Scott's last two copper discs before racing off and saving the other two FBI agents who received such discs. Rushing back to Scott's hideout, the Whizzer then easily captured him and turned Scott over to the police. His subsequent activities are unknown.

natalia romanova.origin: thumb|left|The infant Natasha being raised by Ivan Petrovich after her mother died ===The Early Years=== The exact year and location for the birth of Natalia Romanova is unknown, as is who her parents were. It has been rumored that Natasha (whose name in Russian is: Наталья Романова, Наташа Романова, Наталья Романова-Шостакова) was somehow related to the last ruling czars of Russia, but this rumor was never conclusively proven. ===Raised by a Foster Father=== There are varying accounts of Natasha's early life. One account states that in 1928, there was a fire in Stalingrad which burned down the building that the infant Natasha and her mother were living in. According to the account, just before dying in the fire, Natasha's mother threw her out the window to a Russian soldier below. The soldier's name was Ivan Petrovitch, and he watched over Natasha for her entire life, remaining by her side as her "foster father". Another account dates the fire to the autumn of 1942, during the Battle of Stalingrad. While Natasha was under Ivan's protection, Baron Strucker abducted Natasha and presented her to the organization of assassins called the Hand in Madripoor. Natasha had, in fact, been working under orders from a mysterious source and her "abduction" was to lead her into pretending to become a Master Assassin for the Hand when, in reality, she was to assassinate their Jonin. Logan learned of this and killed the Jonin instead, while also freeing Captain America under the guise of rescuing Natasha. According to this account, Natasha then grew and matured, proving herself to be an amazing athlete and scholar, while gaining distinction in the U.S.S.R. as a ballerina. thumb|left|Red Room training ===The Red Room=== Another account establishes Natasha as being raised from very early childhood by the U.S.S.R.'s "Black Widow Ops" Program in addition to Ivan Petrovitch's care. Petrovitch was said to have taken her to Department X with 28 other young female orphans, where she was trained in combat and espionage at the covert "Red Room" facility. There, she was bio-technologically and psycho-technologically enhanced; an account that provides a rationale for her unusually long and youthful lifespan. In this account she never really trained in ballet in the Bolshoi Theatre, having instead been implanted with artificial memories of doing so. Regardless of which of these accounts (if any) is accurate, eventually it was arranged for Natasha to marry Alexei Shostakov, a distinguished Soviet test pilot. She was later blackmailed into agreeing to act as a spy when her husband's life was threatened. ===The KGB=== The Soviet Union's government intelligence organization (the KGB) decided that Natasha and Alexei's skill sets would make them both superb special operatives and split them up while Alexei was away on a mission. Trained as the Red Guardian, Alexei became the Soviet Union's answer to the United States' Captain America. Natasha was told that her husband had died in an experimental rocket crash. She was drafted into the KGB and became their best operative, becoming excellent at fighting and information gathering. During this time, she had some training under the Winter Soldier and they started a secret relationship. After an incident during an assassination operation, Barnes was deemed unstable and put in cryostasis whenever he was not needed for a mission, leaving Natasha devastated when she found out about it. Natasha later saved Logan from Hydra assassins when he surfaced in America without any memories of his past. She encountered the man again sometime later when she was on a KGB mission to stop three unknown American spies (Logan, Carol Danvers, and Ben Grimm) from stealing Russia's Red Storm Project. ===Early Clashes with Iron Man=== thumb|right|Original costume The Black Widow was assigned to assist Boris Turgenov in the assassination of Professor Anton Vanko for defecting from their country by infiltrating Stark Industries in America. Tony Stark, the original Iron Man, continually foiled her schemes against Stark Industries. Natasha later met the novice archer Hawkeye and set him against Iron Man, and later helped Hawkeye battle Iron Man. Unfortunately, Hawkeye's association with Russian spies would label him a criminal in the early years of his career. Black Widow and Hawkeye next clashed against the novice super-hero Spider-Man. They resumed their focus on Tony Stark, clashing with Iron Man twice more - the first being an attempt to raid Tony Stark's munitions plant. When that mission ended in failure, she was taken back to Russia by her masters and given a new costume that allowed her to scale walls as well as a device that allowed her to fire lines to swing from. fields.personality: Natasha is a professional and sly secret agent who will get any job done, regardless of the difficulty. She went from being one of the best operatives in S.H.I.E.L.D. to a super-hero. She held her own as a part of the Avengers for years, even leading them for a time; however, she does not belong with the super-hero community due to her helping S.H.I.E.L.D. Nevertheless, she will keep her word by being behind the scenes or assisting the Avengers if needed. Despite Natasha being a super-hero, she will always resume her mission of being a spy. Nick Fury commented on Natasha that "running in the shadows is what she was born to do." ===Relationships=== Natasha has had romantic relationships with Tony Stark/Iron Man, Clint Barton/Hawkeye, Michael Corcoran, Hercules, Matt Murdock/Daredevil, James Buchanan "Bucky" Barnes/the Winter Soldier/Captain America VI, and Alexei Shostakov/the Red Guardian.
powers: {{MessageBox
fields.additional_attributes: Infertility: While not an encumbrance to her performance, the serum and biological modifications made to Natasha's physiology grant her impressive resilience; however, the effects of a highly efficient immune system inhibit her reproductive capabilities, making pregnancy impossible for her.
transportation: Natasha uses her Widow's Line, a grappling hook with a retractable line, to swing along rooftops for increased mobility. {{Navigation
fields.notes: Despite Black Widow having been introduced in 1964, it was not until 35 years later in 1999 that the Red Room was established as a part of her backstory in .
fields.trivia: Black Widow was ranked as 74th on IGN's Top 100 Comic Book Heroes in 2011. Black Widow was also ranked as 42nd in "The Top 50 Avengers." She was a S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent Level 10, or "Level 10 Operative". Romanova occasionally cared for a cat that hung around her apartment until she eventually named it Liho and unofficially adopted it. Nick Fury's intelligence classified her as Power Level 7. Natasha has been shown on occasion to have been at least somewhat Russian Orthodox.

natalia vollock.name: Natalia Vollock
natalia vollock.origin: Natalia Vollock was a Red Sky operative and a member of the U.N. Security Council who was planted as part of the ambassador entourage invited to Xavier's Jerusalem Habitat. She along with the other member's were greeted by the Stepford Cuckoos and Magneto who took over the task of giving the ambassadors a tour through the various biomes of Krakoa. As they came to the end of the tour, Sophie read the minds of the delegates including Vollock's and conveyed to Magneto that they were no ambassadors at all but were sent there to spy on the mutants to determine the validity of the situation. Vollock's decision was already made even before the tour began. She would have never agreed to their terms, and now knowing that the others would, she expressed that if this is what they would become then it might be best if they were replaced. Natalia was present at a conference of world powers throwing an after party celebration in honor of the new mutant nation. She bitterly stared at Ms. Frost & X while the former admitted to X that she mentally nudged the untrusting delegate's decision in the UN's vote of accepting the Mutant homeland into its ranks while in telepathic commerce. Still dissatisfied with Krakoa's ingratiation into the world powers, she was then dispatched to liaise with the ruling body of Madripoor, brokering a deal with Homines Verendi by opening trade agreements, offering government power dampening tech in exchange for inside intelligence on the mutant nation.

She asked him if it was true that the Goblin targeted him because of his of connections with Spider-Man. He responded by telling her that Parker Industries have severed all ties from the web-slinger, from the building of his suits and other gadgets. After the conference, Natalie turned around in awe as Peter walked away with his aunt and step-uncle. Natalie later offered J. Jonah Jameson a job on the Fact Channel which he accepted.

natalie turner.origin: Natalie Turner was married, had three children and had a normal life until the end of the Avengers/X-Men war. She woke up and found herself a mutant, with two extra eyes and the capacity to see through walls. She was on her way to the Jean Grey School to learn about her condition when the Red Skull and his S-Men attacked New York and mind controlled the humans to kill the mutants. She was saved by Captain America's Uncanny Avengers.

natalie washington.name: Natalie Washington
natalie washington.origin: Natalie Washington was a neighbor of Riri Williams. They first met when Riri was ten years old. She was working at her garage with the door open, and caught the attention of Natalie, who was riding her bike around the block. Natalie became interested in Riri's work, and they subsequently became friends. When Riri was thirteen, Natalie joined her and her family in a picnic at Marquette Park. In a twist of fate, a car driver opened fire on some bystanders. Riri and Natalie were caught in the line of fire, and Natalie was shot through the heart. She died almost instantly holding Riri's hand. Her final word was, "Why?" Natalie would later serve as the inspiration for the A.I. N.A.T.A.L.I.E.

natalya maximoff.name: Natalya Maximoff
natalya maximoff.origin: Natalya Maximoff was the mother of Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch who seemingly perished attempting to rescue the twins after they were kidnapped by the High Evolutionary and taken to Transia. Her title, the Scarlet Witch, which her daughter inherited, had been passed down throughout the history of her family. While much of her history is unknown and her existence is believed to be a myth, there were some that knew about her including Ulysses Bloodstone and the Eternal Makkari. Wanda first encountered her mother as a spirit when traveling down the Witches' Road with the spirit of Agatha Harkness while investigating mysterious magical attacks on Ireland. Wanda instantly realized that Natalya was her biological mother but, since time can be "vague" on the Witches' Road, Agatha advised Wanda that Natalya could be from the past so she should avoid giving Natalya any foreknowledge that might change history. Keeping their relationship a secret, Wanda had a short conversation with Natalya while getting the chance to witness her mother's magic power in action as she easily dispatched an evil creature identified as a Phooka. Eventually, Natalya vanished as she started to realize her connection to Wanda but her last words before vanishing confirmed that she was from a time before Wanda had even been born. Later, Wanda's search for the truth about her mother led her to Serbia where she encountered Dasha Kolarov, Natalya's best friend, who brought Wanda to where her supposedly-dead adoptive mother, Marya Maximoff, lived. During their reunion, the bodies of Marya and Dasha were possessed by a pair of witch-demons but Wanda, with help from Agatha, exorcised them. Once that was done, Natalya's spirit briefly borrowed Marya's unconscious body so that she could speak with Dasha and tell Wanda that the answers she sought were to be found on the Witches' Road and that she must walk it to the end, further than any witch had ever gone. As the brief time that she could manifest ended, Natalya used her magic to heal Marya's burn-scarred face and restore her beauty. Acting on her mother's advice, Wanda then returned to the Witches' Road to continue her quest to heal the sickness ailing the source of her power. While there, Natalya and Agatha aided her in moving beyond the past which haunted her. At the end of the Witches' Road they encountered Aimless Ones, who attempted to distract the trio long enough for the Abstract Entity Chaos to kill the Goddess of Witchcraft. The witches three combined their magic to drive Chaos away along with Natalya calling out to Pietro to aid Wanda out. Pietro quickly figured she was his mother based on her similarities to Wanda though she was unable to explain the full situation to her "young runner". However, the Goddess had been wounded sufficiently that she continued to die. Natalya then sacrificed her soul and individuality to save Witchcraft, but not before revealing that it was Wanda's own father, not the High Evolutionary, who had killed her all those years ago.

natasha romanoff.origin: thumb|left|The infant Natasha being raised by Ivan Petrovich after her mother died ===The Early Years=== The exact year and location for the birth of Natalia Romanova is unknown, as is who her parents were. It has been rumored that Natasha (whose name in Russian is: Наталья Романова, Наташа Романова, Наталья Романова-Шостакова) was somehow related to the last ruling czars of Russia, but this rumor was never conclusively proven. ===Raised by a Foster Father=== There are varying accounts of Natasha's early life. One account states that in 1928, there was a fire in Stalingrad which burned down the building that the infant Natasha and her mother were living in. According to the account, just before dying in the fire, Natasha's mother threw her out the window to a Russian soldier below. The soldier's name was Ivan Petrovitch, and he watched over Natasha for her entire life, remaining by her side as her "foster father". Another account dates the fire to the autumn of 1942, during the Battle of Stalingrad. While Natasha was under Ivan's protection, Baron Strucker abducted Natasha and presented her to the organization of assassins called the Hand in Madripoor. Natasha had, in fact, been working under orders from a mysterious source and her "abduction" was to lead her into pretending to become a Master Assassin for the Hand when, in reality, she was to assassinate their Jonin. Logan learned of this and killed the Jonin instead, while also freeing Captain America under the guise of rescuing Natasha. According to this account, Natasha then grew and matured, proving herself to be an amazing athlete and scholar, while gaining distinction in the U.S.S.R. as a ballerina. thumb|left|Red Room training ===The Red Room=== Another account establishes Natasha as being raised from very early childhood by the U.S.S.R.'s "Black Widow Ops" Program in addition to Ivan Petrovitch's care. Petrovitch was said to have taken her to Department X with 28 other young female orphans, where she was trained in combat and espionage at the covert "Red Room" facility. There, she was bio-technologically and psycho-technologically enhanced; an account that provides a rationale for her unusually long and youthful lifespan. In this account she never really trained in ballet in the Bolshoi Theatre, having instead been implanted with artificial memories of doing so. Regardless of which of these accounts (if any) is accurate, eventually it was arranged for Natasha to marry Alexei Shostakov, a distinguished Soviet test pilot. She was later blackmailed into agreeing to act as a spy when her husband's life was threatened. ===The KGB=== The Soviet Union's government intelligence organization (the KGB) decided that Natasha and Alexei's skill sets would make them both superb special operatives and split them up while Alexei was away on a mission. Trained as the Red Guardian, Alexei became the Soviet Union's answer to the United States' Captain America. Natasha was told that her husband had died in an experimental rocket crash. She was drafted into the KGB and became their best operative, becoming excellent at fighting and information gathering. During this time, she had some training under the Winter Soldier and they started a secret relationship. After an incident during an assassination operation, Barnes was deemed unstable and put in cryostasis whenever he was not needed for a mission, leaving Natasha devastated when she found out about it. Natasha later saved Logan from Hydra assassins when he surfaced in America without any memories of his past. She encountered the man again sometime later when she was on a KGB mission to stop three unknown American spies (Logan, Carol Danvers, and Ben Grimm) from stealing Russia's Red Storm Project. ===Early Clashes with Iron Man=== thumb|right|Original costume The Black Widow was assigned to assist Boris Turgenov in the assassination of Professor Anton Vanko for defecting from their country by infiltrating Stark Industries in America. Tony Stark, the original Iron Man, continually foiled her schemes against Stark Industries. Natasha later met the novice archer Hawkeye and set him against Iron Man, and later helped Hawkeye battle Iron Man. Unfortunately, Hawkeye's association with Russian spies would label him a criminal in the early years of his career. Black Widow and Hawkeye next clashed against the novice super-hero Spider-Man. They resumed their focus on Tony Stark, clashing with Iron Man twice more - the first being an attempt to raid Tony Stark's munitions plant. When that mission ended in failure, she was taken back to Russia by her masters and given a new costume that allowed her to scale walls as well as a device that allowed her to fire lines to swing from. She once more attempted to get Hawkeye to help her destroy Iron Man. The pair almost succeeded, but when Black Widow was injured, Hawkeye retreated to get her to safety. fields.personality: Natasha is a professional and sly secret agent who will get any job done, regardless of the difficulty. She went from being one of the best operatives in S.H.I.E.L.D. to a super-hero. She held her own as a part of the Avengers for years, even leading them for a time; however, she does not belong with the super-hero community due to her helping S.H.I.E.L.D. Nevertheless, she will keep her word by being behind the scenes or assisting the Avengers if needed. Despite Natasha being a super-hero, she will always resume her mission of being a spy. Nick Fury commented on Natasha that "running in the shadows is what she was born to do." ===Relationships=== Natasha has had romantic relationships with Tony Stark/Iron Man, Clint Barton/Hawkeye, Michael Corcoran, Hercules, Matt Murdock/Daredevil, James Buchanan "Bucky" Barnes/the Winter Soldier/Captain America VI, and Alexei Shostakov/the Red Guardian.
powers: {{MessageBox
fields.additional_attributes: Infertility: While not an encumbrance to her performance, the serum and biological modifications made to Natasha's physiology grant her impressive resilience; however, the effects of a highly efficient immune system inhibit her reproductive capabilities, making pregnancy impossible for her.
transportation: Natasha uses her Widow's Line, a grappling hook with a retractable line, to swing along rooftops for increased mobility. {{Navigation
fields.notes: Despite Black Widow having been introduced in 1964, it was not until 35 years later in 1999 that the Red Room was established as a part of her backstory in .
fields.trivia: Black Widow was ranked as 74th on IGN's Top 100 Comic Book Heroes in 2011. Black Widow was also ranked as 42nd in "The Top 50 Avengers." She was a S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent Level 10, or "Level 10 Operative". Romanova occasionally cared for a cat that hung around her apartment until she eventually named it Liho and unofficially adopted it. Nick Fury's intelligence classified her as Power Level 7. Natasha has been shown on occasion to have been at least somewhat Russian Orthodox.

natashia repina.name: Natashia Repina
natashia repina.origin: Natashia "Tashi" Repina was a young 13-old mutant from Carnelia. One day — due to an accident caused by her powers — her parents died. Tashi escaped and hid in a warehouse. Lonely and scared, she fell asleep and was trapped in her own nightmares unable to wake up. She was discovered by several guards, but, affected by her power, they were twisted into monsters which only fueled her fear. left|thumb|Before the manifestation of her powers The situation alarmed mutants on Krakoa, so the New Mutants went to Carnelia. Karma tried to contact Tashi with telepathy, which backfired and dragged her and other team members into the girl's nightmares. Eventually, Wildside managed to get close enough to Tashi to affect her with his powers and transform her nightmares into happy dreams. As a result, she and everyone else were freed. The New Mutants brought Tashi to Krakoa, where Forge created a special containment reservoir for her. Dani Moonstar tasked Maxime and Manon with taking care of Tashi. Manon proposed helping Tashi feel better by removing her memories about causing the death of her parents. Moonstar refused because they can't remake people, even if they think it would help them. She told them to only help Tashi stay calm until they found a way to help her control her powers. thumb|right|Deformed look Later, she asked Dani to be her partner in the Crucible so that she could regain her old appearance, but Dani refused her request. She was instead comforted by Anole, a fellow non-passing mutant. Under the guidance of Amahl Farouk, Cosmar and her friends began experimenting with the corpses in the Boneyard, so as to transfer their consciousness to one of the bodies in order for them to look normal. They were interrupted by Scout, who was concerned by their actions. On the night of the Hellfire Gala, they found Scout dead while exploring Planet Arakko. Deciding they couldn't trust the adults after their recent secretive and unhelpful behavior, and not wanting to get Farouk caught up in something he'd probably get blamed for, they decided to get Gabby resurrected themselves by going to Arbor Magna to use Cerebro and put a copy of her mind back into her body (which was being controlled by No-Girl.) When they got there, No-Girl tried to mind control Tempus but they were confronted by Wolfsbane in wolf form. thumb|left|Restored to normal proportions by Masque (Earth-616)|Masque Eventually, the New Mutants took her to see Masque, who was using his powers as a plastic surgeon at the Moira MacTaggert Memorial Public Hospital in Madripoor. Masque helped Tashi restore her body to normal proportions, with only the purple skin and yellow right eye showing as part of her mutation.

natchez nate.name: Natchez Nate
natchez nate.origin: Natchez Nate was a ruthless outlaw who was active during the days of the American Frontier. His biggest mistake was in working with fellow outlaw Blackie Horn, who ultimately double crossed him. Nate found himself buried up to his neck in the desert and left to die. His face was horribly mutilated due to the desert ants eating his upper lip, eye lids, the bridge of his nose and his left eye. He managed to survive and was discovered by a gold prospector who freed him. Nate returned the favor by putting the prospector in the same predicament as him. Nate then went to the town of Santa Sierra where he slew Blackie Horn and his loyal men and took control of his surviving gang members. He then attempted to instigate a range war between local cattle men and sheep herders by taking key members in a feud over land rights and burying them in the desert to suffer the same fate that he himself had escaped. As tensions between the two factions began to flare, the outlaw hero Kid Colt rode into town and investigated the rising conflict and found Nate's desert-consumed victims. Realizing that Nate was instigating the war, Kid Colt tracked him and his gang down and shot them all dead. He then revealed the truth to the two warring factions, allowing peace to return to the region.

nate hackett.name: Nate Hackett
nate hackett.origin: Nate Hackett was once Matt Murdock's childhood bully and had been the one to give him the nickname "Daredevil". He was also the last person Matt saw before he was blinded by radioactive waste while saving an old stranger. Years later, Nate came across Matt and asked for his help to sue the state. He had been a member of the Sons of the Serpent, but left before they started becoming too political. While working as a radio engineer he had been arrested for past Serpent business, he didn't lose anything but his job. He wants to sue the state for false arrest. After much thought, Matt agrees to tutor him in representing himself in court. The trial is interrupted when the judge shoots Nate. Apparently, he and everyone else in the room were Sons of the Serpent. Following a shootout, Nate was rushed to hospital and was visited by Matt Murdock, who told him that the police arresting him were in fact Sons of the Serpent.

nate thurman.name: Nate Thurman
nate thurman.first_appearance: Captain America/Nick Fury: Blood Truce Vol 1 1
nate thurman.origin: An agent of S.H.I.E.L.D.. His brother, CIA field officer George Thurman, had been killed by KGB torturer Dmitri Panshin. At the end of the Cold War, Nate Thurman was involved in a conspiracy of S.H.I.E.L.D. agents who opposed to Communist war criminals escaping trial and punishment by deserting; conspirator leader Tom Gittes pressured Thurman to join them by appealing to George's memory when Panshin had a chance to be hired by the U.S. government under S.H.I.E.L.D. protection. When S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier security boss "Dum Dum" Dugan was injured, Thurman covered his possition temporarily, working hand to hand with Gittes. At that point, S.H.I.E.L.D. involved Captain America in the operation to protect Panshin. Agent Orange was unable to get Panshin in Prague, but kidnapped Panshin's young son Sergei Panshin, which Gittes then used as a bargaining chip to have Panshin delivered, while pretending that Hydra was behind the operation; Thurman asked Gittes about this, but was disgusted at the idea of endangering children, as this made them no better than Panshin. Gittes insistently reminded Thurman of his dead brother. Agent Orange exchanged Sergei for Panshin, and took Panshin to the Helicarrier to submit him to a kangaroo court. Once Agent Orange approached, Thurman, following the plan, ordered a completely lockdown of the ship while Gittes illegally arrested Dugan. Thurman then attended the mock trial of Panshin, finding it ridiculous. However, Agent Orange had been followed by Captain America, the Titanium Man and S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Nick Fury. Agent Orange was defeated and Captain America found Panshin's cell, but Gittes confronted him with three other conspirator agents, including Goldman and Thurman, and intended to shoot Captain America dead if needed. Goldman refused to shoot Captain America himeslf, then when Gittes unsheathed his gun, Thurman punched and arrested Gittes, sick of how Gittes had used his brother's death for his own purposes.

nathan carpenter.name: Nathan Carpenter
nathan carpenter.origin: Nathan Carpenter was the strict owner of WNRV radio, the popular radio station in Citrusville, Florida. He regularly sent Richard Rory off to do news reports for the radio station outside of his regular duties as the late night DJ. When Carpenter sent Rory out to cover the mayor's address to the public following the apparent death of the Man-Thing, Carpenter fired Rory after he tried to stop an angry mob from burning text books for the radio station .; Rory gave Carpenter a brief comeuppance a short time later when he later struck it rich. Coming back to Citrusville with Jennifer Walters (secretly the She-Hulk) Rory bought WNRV, and then fired Carpenter. However, Rory's bad luck came back in spades when Rory fried the radio station's equipment while trying to communicate with the Man-Wolf, who at the time was trapped on a micro-world.; With no other alternative, Rory sold the radio station back to Carpenter at a measly $5.00 and found himself kicked off the property to boot. However, Richard left with the only object of value from the radio station: the valuable recording which he made of his communication with the Man-Wolf.

nathan chase.name: Nathan Chase
nathan chase.species: and Cable were combined in a Marvel versus DC crossover (Human Cyborg)
nathan chase.origin: Nathan Chase was a manhunter. He was built out of flesh and machine, strung together with cybernetic cable. Brought together by the corrupt New Gotham mayor the Big Question (Edward Nigma Fisk), Wired and his fellow assassins, Lethal (Sergei Minerva) and Deadeye (Bill Lawton), discovered that they had defeats at the hands of the same women (Dare and Catsai) in common. Together, Wired, Deadeye, and Lethal figured they could teach their mutual enemies a lesson in respect. Working for the Big Question made them think that the road to riches was all puzzled out. Catsai and Dare were making their way up the Arkham Tower and killing anyone standing between them and their target, Big Question. They had already faced and killed 13 mercenaries hired by Big Question, including Deadeye and Lethal. They were climbing up an Arkham Tower elevator shaft and conversing with each other. Wired overheard Dare telling her partner than killing Big Question was just another job. He cut the cable on which they were climbing, and also joined their conversation. Wired observed than in their line of work, there is no such thing as just as job. One has to be into it to get the most out of it. He asked the two women who wanted to die first. Catsai started saying that she was getting tired of Big Question's "toy soldiers". Before long Wired was dead, though it was unclear if he was killed by Catsai or Dare. He was impaled on his own weapon, a large spiked blade. Catsai and Dare used Wired's thrown corpse to open up a metal door.

fields.notes: Due to his cybernetic physiology, it is unlikely that Wired actually died when he was impaled by his own weapon. He might still be revived. fields.trivia: Wired's first name "Nathan", his glowing eye, and the big red X on his uniform all derive from Cable. His last name "Chase" derives from , though Chase is that character's first name. His spike probably derives from Chase Lawler's tendency to use spiked weapons. It is uncertain whether Wired is a cyborg or another kind of techno-organic creature, like Cable. His introduction says that he is a manhunter, which typically means someone who hunts down a target in a manhunt. In the DC universe, there are multiple heroes and villains known as " ". Prominent among them are the (plural), an entire race of extraterrestrial robots. They reportedly control or manipulate several of the other Manhunter characters. Wired's uniform is a combination of Cable's blue uniform from the 90s and the Manhunter costume of , who was the current Manhunter in DC Comics at the time. Wired's uniform prominently displays the colors blue and red, which could also possibly be in reference to the uniform of an earlier Manhunter, called . Wired is one of two Amalgam characters based on Cable. The other is Niles Cable. They somewhat resemble each other, though their hair color is different and Niles has a beard. Uncertain if they are connected to each other.

nathan cooper.name: Nathan Cooper
nathan cooper.origin: Nathan Cooper was transformed into Megaman by an alien which saved his life after he almost died in an accident. Falling into a black lake which sent him one million years into the future and became mutated and disfigured as a result, and was encountered an entity which kept him prisoner. He sought revenge on his nephew, Caps Cooper, for supposedly abandoning him (in fact, Caps had believed him dead) and fought Nova. He was horrified when he discovered that the alien, which he believed had been keeping him prisoner, was actually in love with him. He went with Caps to see his ex-wife, and found that she had already moved on. He began attacking his wifes new partner before being interrupted by Nova, and they fought through the Coney Island Fun House before circling back to his old home. As he began fighting Nova again, the Protector appeared declaring its love for him. Cooper begged his wife to say that she loved him but she kept silent, while the Protector took him back to its time . He was captured by the enigmatic alien, the Stranger, and was imprisoned in the Stranger's Laboratory World for the alien to study him. He remained there until freed by Overmind.

nathan dolly.name: Nathan Dolly
nathan dolly.species: Human Voodoo magic user, with mind transferred into artificial bodies
nathan dolly.origin: ===Mr. Doll=== Nathan Dolly, a doll collector and professional deal in curios and art objects, travelled the world for business and, when returning home in North Hollywood, he always brought (or sent) his wife Priscilla a doll. Due to this, Mrs. Dolly eventually amassed a sizeable assortment of dolls from all over the world at home. While Dolly was on a trip to Africa, a local witch-doctor naïvely befriended Dolly, but Dolly instead stole from the witch-doctor a doll, which was specifically a magical talisman or voodoo doll that the wielder could use to cause pain on other people, along with the magical secret to use it. By changing the doll's likeness, Dolly could cause pain to specific people, so he trained himself to modify the doll's features quickly and, once he returned to the U.S., he decided to use his magic to increase his income through criminal extortion. Taking the alias of Mr. Doll (though he was also called Mr. Pain in some reports), he extorted three New York City millionaires successively, torturing them with the doll until they were so intimidated that they legally signed over their personal fortunes to Mr. Doll (much to the dismay of NYPD, which could not even get the victims to report) the crime. The third of these men was tycoon Charleton Carter, owner of Carter Steel; Mr. Doll entered Carter's estate repeatedly, knowing that no one could stop him, and caused Carter enough pain that he gave in. In the process, Carter had to interrupt his dealings with business associate Anthony Stark of Stark Industries, which motivated Stark to investigate his secret identity as Iron Man (Coincidentally, Stark was the next millionaire that Mr. Doll had planned to extort). Wearing his first Iron Man armor, Stark followed Mr. Doll, who entered Carter's estate and extorted Carter with the doll; Iron Man confronted Mr. Doll, but Mr. Doll quickly altered his doll to replicate Iron Man's mask and caused him intense pain. Stark, who had heart problems, suffered damage and the attack caused a big strain on his chest plate mechanism, to the point that he was unable to keep his heart beating strong enough to support the extra weight of the armor and he fled by jumping from Carter's house by a cliff to the sea. Believing that Iron Man had died, Mr. Doll modified his doll to continue torturing Carter, who at the time was scared of a man who had just defeated Iron Man; but by changing the shape of the doll, Stark stopped taking damage and recovered, emerging from the sea. Unaware that Iron Man had survived, Mr. Doll gloated over his victory in his lair. Stark returned home and, realizing due to his last fight that his own armor was too heavy and consumed too much energy due to weight alone, decided to build a new suit, lighter, with the explicit purpose of making up for her defeat at the hands of Doll. At the same time, the police contacted Stark, correctly deducing that Mr. Doll would go after Stark next, and asking Stark to serve as a decoy. As expected, Mr. Doll entered Stark's factory, using his doll to get rid of the guards. Iron Man challenged Mr. Doll, but once again Mr. Doll transformed the figure to give it Iron Man's face so he'd control Iron Man, ordering him to expel the security. He then changed the face of the figure to represent Stark and tortured him (not knowing that Stark was Iron Man and was by his side), and then coerced Iron Man to go find Stark. However, Stark took advantage of that time to develop and build a device that could change the figure's shape at close range and make it take on the appearance of Mr. Doll himself. When Iron Man confronted Mr. Doll again, he tried to give the figure Iron Man's face, but Iron Man's device also altered the figure, giving it Mr. Doll's face instead. Before realizing this change, Mr. Doll used the figure to unintentionally torture himself. Surprised by the unexpected pain, Mr. Doll dropped the doll to the ground, and fell unconscious himself while Iron Man had the police come to arrest him. Defeated by Iron Man, Mr. Doll was arrested and the doll was taken away, apparently to be then destroyed by Iron Man. Possibly, the effects of his extortion of Carter and other millionaires were reversed. Although his encounter with Iron Man was a one-time one, Mr. Doll gained a certain reputation and, when Zoltan Drago built a wax museum with figures of supervillains, one of the figures represented Mr. Doll. However, Nathan Dolly apparently abandoned the Mr. Doll alias for good. ===Life-force transfer to figurines and mannequins=== Once he was released from prison, Dolly decided that he wanted another doll with a power similar to the one he had had. He traveled to Mount Wundagore, a peak in the Balkan Mountains, where he found by chance an old toymaker, Django Maximoff, who carved dolls, puppets death effigies and small wooden figurines. fields.personality: The Brothers Grimm were melodramatic criminals who enjoyed showing off to their victims, mocking them and humiliating them, either in public or in private (as when they blackmailed James Wyatt, harassing him even if nobody else could see). They were able to organize complex criminal activities and hire other criminals, while also working for a third party as Pyrotechnics, and although they managed to amass a little fortune, they purpose was not merely wealth or they would have targeted other victims - In fact, they intended to obtain a human body to transfer their shared life essence into it, yet they also committed unrelated crimes and acts of mayhem that gave them fame at least locally due to the press coverage of their crimes. This may have been due to their showmanship, or maybe because the magic may have affected their behavior. During their crimes, the Brothers Grimm sometimes spoke in forced accent ("Monsieur", "Pardhuh", "Tra-la", "This son a'ole Erin"), possibly as part of their act. When pretending to be Jacob and William, the latter was more elegant and gentlemanly while the former was shy and rejected attention, especially when he believed that others could obtain information from him; William repeatedly claimed he didn't have the time to talk with Jessica Drew. Both brothers also worked together at the Playhouse Theater. Mr. Doll had been an untrusting person who cared for nobody except for himself and his wife. Before obtaining his magic doll, he had travelled the world for business and always remembered to bring a doll to his wife as a treat. However, when he met a trustful African witch-doctor, he didn't hesitate to steal his secrets and use them to obtain a fortune by torturing and blackmailing tycoons, worrying little about the effects it may cause on them, their companies or other people. He mocked his victims pretending to be reasonable, then twisting his words to fulfill agreements, and he walked with confidence even in other people's domains. He also kept a secret lair with African decor, including shields and figures; it's unclear whether this, or his peculiar headdress similar to the witch-doctor's, contributed to his magicks or were merely personal choices. After losing this magic, Mr. Doll travelled the world to obtain new means to go back to his old ways, and was ambitious and arrogant enough to try to use magic in ways that were not intended when he accidentally transferred his life force to two dolls at once.
transportation: this was not confirmed with the Nathan Dolly version.
fields.notes: The Brothers Grimm have profiles or entries in the following books: Appendix entries for the Brothers Grimm in and for Mr. Doll in , even if they were known to be the same person (The First Appearance listed in each entry was the first appearance for that alias). First complete entry in , focusing on the Grimes brothers. Roleplaying-game-adapted entry in , with the History almost-verbatim repeated from the previous Handbook, but the Powers adapted for the game. The RPG also gives the Grimes a profile as part of the Night Shift (Earth-616) in . Mentioned in passing in the Grimes brother's profile in Sharing profile with the Grimes in and . Mr. Doll was also included in a pin-up with several other enemies of Iron Man in , although Doll had had only one appearance at that point. There have been a number of inconsistencies in this character throughout his appearances, including the following: Mr. Doll's figure seen in sometimes have clearly-carved legs, and sometimes does not. The Puppet Master's profile in and says that Mr. Doll used a doll made from wood of Wundagore Mountain; however, Mr. Doll clearly uses a figure made of clay and obtained in Africa, as seen in . Sources were initially unclear about the place where Nathan Dolly acquired the Brothers Grimm figurines to Django Maximoff. In , Maximoff said he had settled in Vladivostok and in a flashback he's seen selling one of the figurines to Dolly. The Brothers Grimm's profile in , in a text repeated in , says that Dolly bought the figures while on Wundagore Mountain, in the Balkans; in the comic , Mrs. Dolly mentions how her husband bought the figurines in the Balkans. A more recent source, (Brothers Grimm's profile), says that Dolly indeed met Maximoff while the latter was visiting his former home, and bought the figurines there, meaning that Maximoff had settled in Vladivostok, but sold the figurines to Dolly in the Balkans. The Brothers Grimm's profile in , in a text repeated in , says that Nathan tried to animate both figurines at once, which left his body lifeless. The other sources say that he was not actively trying to animate two figurines, but he made the mistake of trying to animate one figurine while the other figurine was in the same room, thus too close and affecting the spell. The Night Shift's profile in confuses the figurines and the mannikins, suggesting that Dolly projected his life force and animated the dolls, then continuing with the idea that the artificial body was in use later during his criminal career. , Brothers Grimm's profile, said that the items in the Brothers' "bag of tricks" were always hand-held, small enough to fit in the palm of one Brother Grimm. However, the "dummies" that simulated a full-size Brother Grimm, seen in , are obviously too big for that, even if listed as one of those "tricks." The Brothers Grimm's updated profile in corrects this by saying that the tricks are often hand-held. Brothers Grimm's profile in says that a single Brother led Spider-Woman and Jerry Hunt to the Playhouse, where he captured and restrained them both. In , we see that one Brother Grimm (possibly Jacob) was the bait for both Spider-Woman and Hunt, and defeated Spider-Woman, while his brother knocked Hunt down; and, once Spider-Woman and Hunt had been captured, they were taken to the Playhouse (thus they were captured by both Brothers before reaching the Playhouse, not by one Brother and then taken to the Playhouse). In , Spider-Woman says that the Brothers Grimm never repeat the same trick twice. However, they had used the blast attack several times against her in and ; and they would use the gas attack in Spider-Woman #11 and . Brothers Grimm's profile in says that Jerry Hunt was in a ceremonial pentagram to be possessed by Nathan. In , Hunt is kept in something called Circle of Transfer, as were the Brothers; while pentagrams are something different used to protect other people in the stage that will not be part of the transfer, including Mrs. Dolly, Magnus, and Spider-Woman. When describing the origin of the second Brothers Grimm, the Brothers Grimm's profile in (in a text that's repeated in ) says that "Percy and Barton Grimes felt compelled to try the costumes on". In - , we see that Barton shows an interest in trying the suit on, not because of a supernatural pressure but because he hoped to find the Brothers Grimm's tricks; and in any case, Percy was reluctant from the very beginning. The list of mind-controlling supervillains shown to the Avengers in Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S. included a picture of Mr. Doll, who could never control minds, only bodies (He coerced people to do his bidding with the threat of causing them pain; but if he could have controlled minds, then Anthony Stark would have been unable to build a device to modify the doll, as he'd have been prompted to obey Mr. Doll's commands). This image also shows his headset painted in yellow color, while it had been blue. Brother Grimm's relationship to Pyrotechnics is uncle
fields.trivia: Mr. Doll's doll was identified unambiguously as a voodoo doll. Mr. Doll started his career and first met Iron Man soon after the Fantastic Four had their first encounter with the Molecule Man. One of the Brothers Grimm was cold and calculating, the other being flamboyant and deranged. In Pyrotechnics, Spider-Woman saw William, in civilian gear, and one of the Brothers Grimm at the same time, who had to be Jacob. As this Brother Grimm was jokingly aggressive, it can be inferred that Jacob was the "deranged" Brother and William was the "calculating" one. When Jessica Drew was introduced to Jacob and William, she was told that Jacob had worked with her father Jonathan Drew, although Jacob claimed to not remember Jonathan. William had also worked with Jonathan at Pyrotechnics, but he behaved in a suspicious way, insisting on leaving to take care of business. Jessica decided to excuse herself and follow William, even if she could have stayed and questioned Jacob. It is confirmed that Nathan Dolly designed and manufactured the Brothers Grimm's uniforms by himself (though possibly while occupying the mannikins), even if Jerry Hunt believed that Mrs. Dolly possibly had sewing talent and had sewn small Brothers Grimm suits for two figurines. The Brothers Grimm obtained some reputation, at least in Los Angeles, due to his spectacular crimes terrorizing the city with their unusual weapons. When Jessica found that Mrs. Dolly owned figurines dressed as Brothers Grimm, Jessica's boyfriend Jerry Hunt did not consider that suspicious: Hunt believed that, as the Brothers Grimm had appeared in the news, Mrs. Dolly may simply had seen their photos and decided to sew replica suits for the dolls; he also believed that Brothers Grimm merchandise, including figurines, may be for sale due to their fame.

nathan garrett.species: Human, Nathan Garrett built the equipment and weapons that he adopted as the Black Knight.
nathan garrett.origin: ===Early Life=== thumb|left|150px|Nathan GarrettProfessor Nathan Garrett was born in London and was the descendant of Sir Percy of Scandia, the heroic Black Knight of Arthurian legend, but he lacked his heroic nature. Garrett achieved international respect as a brilliant research scientist and inventor whose particular specialty was genetic manipulation. He earned his doctorate at Oxford University and later taught there as a professor. It may have been at Oxford that Garrett fell in with and joined colleagues who were political leftists, and became a radical communist: it is not known at what point in his life, Garrett became a spy for the People's Republic of China. At some point Garrett visited the castle he had inherited, Garrett Castle, where Sir Percy of Scandia was buried. The spirit of Sir Percy appeared to Garrett and presented him with the opportunity to become a modern day Black Knight crusading against evil. Garrett saw the original Black Knight's enchanted Ebony Blade in a scabbard near the tomb of Sir Percy, but, being unworthy, was unsuccessful in drawing the sword. Hence Sir Percy did not make Garrett his successor as the Black Knight. ===Giant-Man=== Garrett moved to the United States of America, where his sister had gone to live, and he became a naturalized American citizen. Garrett led a highly distinguished career, continuing his scientific research, but he also acted as the head of an espionage ring. Finally, he was captured by Hank Pym, and charged with treason for delivering American government scientific secrets to agents of Communist China. In order to prevent Garrett from betraying them at his trial, the Communist Chinese intelligence agency saw that Garrett's bail was paid. Garrett then fled the United States, using a counterfeit passport. Garrett hid in a Balkan kingdom, rented a castle and plotted his revenge. He was determined to make himself a match for Giant-Man. Inspired by his encounter with Sir Percy's ghost and by a statue of a winged horse that he saw in this European country, Garrett decided to devise for himself the costumed identity of a criminal Black Knight. Using his genius at genetic manipulation, Garrett artificially mutated the horse Elendil to give it wings enabling it to fly. He also devised highly advanced weaponry, much of which he built into a power lance, and an armored costume similar to the original Black Knights. Garrett secretly returned to the United States and robbed an armored car in the guise of the Black Knight. Giant-Man and the Wasp confronted the Knight when he attempted to steal a state-of-the-art helicopter. Garrett subdued Giant-Man with bolos and powerful cables, and he unleashed his itch-ray on him. Giant-Man escaped by shrinking to ant size and reunited with the Wasp. Unnerved for the humiliating defeat, he fled on Elendil and vowed revenge. ===Masters of Evil=== The Black Knight was soon recruited by Baron Heinrich Zemo to serve as a member of his Masters of Evil. He intent was to prove his worthiness by kidnapping Princess Elena Stragosz of Ksavia, while she was with her father, Archduke Emil Stragosz, in New York City, attending a United Nations Security Council meeting. The Knight fought the honor guard and Spider-Man, but his high school classmate, Sally Avril, died in a car accident while she attempted to photograph the event, and Garrett escaped. He took Elena to the Chrysler Building, where he was protected by dozens of medieval-clad minions while he contacted Zemo to relay his success. Later, Spider-Man arrived and threw aside the Knight's lackeys, and chased him out of the building. Spider-Man angrily beat him until the Human Torch intervened. As Zemo ordered the collapse of a nearby wall, the heroes were distracted and the Knight was removed. Despite this, Zemo allowed the Knight to join his Masters of Evil. Later, the Masters attacked New York City, spraying the Adhesive X on the populace, trying to lure the Avengers into a confrontation. But, they were defeated when Rick Jones and his Teen Brigade replaced it with an antidote developed by Paste-Pot Pete, who wanted parole with his cooperation. The Avengers defeated the Masters of Evil, the Knight proving no match for the Asgardian thunder god Thor. Even though Thor enjoyed riding Elendil, he knew the horse didn't belong to him, so he didn't claim ownership. The horse soon circled the state penitentiary where Garrett was held, and Garrett, using his equipment, escaped. He wanted revenge on the Avengers, and he attacked the Stark Industries plant in Long Island and held Happy Hogan hostage, in order to attract Iron Man; still, the Knight was defeated and brought to prison. In prison, he and the Melter were allowed to wear their armors for a demonstration to a scientific delegation from Washington. But before that could happen, the Enchantress and the Executioner freed them so they could rejoin the Masters of Evil. Their battle with the Avengers resulted in Zemo's apparent death

equipment: Body Armor: The Black Knight wore a lightweight full-body suit of electrically-insulated steel-alloy chainmail that protected him from projectiles like 45-caliber bullets at close range
however, it didn't protect him from a long fall. Also, his helmet visor could emit a bright light to blind foes temporarily. The suit weighed about 60 pounds.
fields.notes: Much of the Black Knight's weaponry, as well as his general modus operandi, has been imitated by the Dreadknight.
fields.trivia: This character appears in TSR, Inc.'s RPG adventure The Weird, Weird West. In the plot, he had been hired by Doctor Doom in 1968 to travel back in time to 1871 Dodge City. Alongside with other super-villains (including Sandman, Scorpion, and Mysterio), he was to provide support to Doom while he analyzed a time anomaly and tried to obtain profit from it. Doom took his lackeys (no name was provided for the team) to a Krozzar camp to deal with the Krozzars. Doom eventually found the origin of the anomaly, a chronovore, but he and his lackeys were also found by time-traveling heroes from 1989, and defeated.

nathan jefferson.name: Nathan Jefferson
nathan jefferson.origin: Nathan Jefferson was a reporter who worked for the National Pulse. At one point in his life he was married but got divorced when his wife became religious. When 'Captain Marvel' returned to life and wealthy heiress Julia Starr formed the Church of Hala to worship him, Jefferson grew suspicious and began investigating. Although his editor and colleagues did not believe the story was worth writing about, Jefferson visiting the church on multiple occasions and tried to speak with Julia Starr, now going by 'Mother Starr', to no avail. Jefferson went so far as to break into Starr's office to search it for information, which led her to almost shoot him when she discovered him trespassing. On one of these searches he discovered that the church was sending large amounts of money to one of their branches in Los Angeles, where Jefferson had previously lived and were he did not wish to return. Despite his wish to stay away from LA, Jefferson stole an expense card to get their and go undercover as a recruit of the church to learn more about them for his story. Jefferson worked undercover as a member of the church but began settling in and loosing his objectivity as he found no scandals to uncover and instead learned more of all the good the church was doing. Nathan was discovered and brought before Mother Starr who he convinced of his devotion after telling her he recruited a homeless couple to the church so they would have something to eat and somewhere to sleep. During this conversation they were approached by Captain Marvel who told them they were doing good work though he was, uncomfortable with the religious aspects. After this conversation, Captain Marvel began working with them, and led them to in Sudan to provide aid there. A warehouse they were speaking on top of was bombed, killing Julia Starr which Nathan witnessed and tried to get Captain Marvel to safety, though he chose to begin cleaning up Al-Fashir instead. Nathan then spoke to a news channel about what Captain Marvel chose to do. Once Captain Marvel again disappeared Nathan was still a devoted member of the church and spoke before them about how Captain Marvel's desire to end war actually ceased all warfare for 24 hours. Nathan had become a true devotee, feeling that Captain Marvel had saved him and gave his life purpose. During Nathan's speech a Skrull disguised as a member of the church was going to explode itself, having been chosen to act as a suicide bomber and was about to blow but was whisked away by Captain Marvel who moved so quickly he seemed to merely be a beam of light.

nathan lubensky.name: Nathan Lubensky
nathan lubensky.first_appearance: Peter Parker, The Spectacular Spider-Man Vol 1 47
nathan lubensky.origin: ===Dating Aunt May=== After May Parker underwent a coronary bypass operation she met Nathan at the Restwell Nursing Home. May and Nathan were soon engaged. Peter Parker was asked by Aunt May to follow Nathan into town. When Nathan left his bank, muggers accosted him. Peter drove them off as Spider-Man with help from a woman and her cane. As the woman helped Nathan with his heart pills, Spidey retrieved Nathan's satchel and found it full of money. After he came home, his condition worsened, as his heart was weakening steadily: he was tended by May, who was terrified at the thought of living without him. Confronted later by Peter, Nathan admitted he had cashed out his life insurance policy. ===Death=== Having bet all his money on Raymond Trask's death, he attended the grand opening of his new casino yacht on the Hudson River with May. After the Vulture tried to take Aunt May hostage, Nathan leapt on his back and the villain flew off with him, who soon fell, but he was caught by Spidey. While the Vulture was lifted by Doctor Octopus in his Hover Jet, Nathan eventually died in Aunt May's arms. May mourned Nathan's death deeply and so did, surprisingly, Adrian Toomes. When the criminal realized he was dying of cancer, he set about putting his life in order before he died. He confronted May at her home, asking for her forgiveness. He had not forgotten the kindness that Nathan had shown him years prior at Restwell Nursing Home. May slapped him, refusing to forgive. Peter showed up later and May told him that a part of her heart died when Ben was murdered, another part when Peter's parents died and that the last part may have died with Nathan. ===Dead No More=== Years later, Nathan was one of the many allies of Peter Parker brought back to life by Spider-Man's clone Ben Reilly, who was acting as the new Jackal, as an incentive to convince Spider-Man to join his enterprise. When the Jackal's ally Doctor Octopus turned against him and set off the decay of the bodies of his subjects, Nathan's body started breaking down. While many of the people the Jackal cloned back to life didn't survive the decay before Spider-Man put a halt to it, others managed to survive. Nathan's subsequent fate is unknown.

nathan martin.name: Nathan Martin
nathan martin.origin: Commissioner Nathan Martin recruited Captain America to work as an undercover police officer. The Commissioner's goal was to find out what had happen to seven of his patrolmen and more than a dozen city officials who had gone missing and he was going to use Captain America in the guise of a new rookie recruit as bait. No one outside of Martin and Captain America was to know about their agreement due to Martin's lack of trust of who might be behind the disappearances combined with the Commissioner already having lost two special agents previously. Captain America soon found that the Grey Gargoyle was the one responsible for the missing people, he had been keeping them encased in stone in a graveyard unbeknownst to any passersby. Luckily those the Gargoyle imprisoned in stone were not dead and only contained temporarily within, requiring the Grey Gargoyle to reapply his touch to extend the stony duration when needed. Once Captain America and the Falcon discovered the missing individuals and chased away the Gargoyle, the missing people were freed of their imprisonment.

nathan patrofsky.name: Nathan Patrofsky
nathan patrofsky.origin: Nathan was born in Poland sometime in the first half of the 20th Century. When Nazi Germany invaded his country, he was one of the millions rounded up and placed in the Nazi death camps, from which he was liberated by the Allies. At some point he married a woman, Shirley, who predeceased him. In his old age, he settled down in New York City's District X. He lost his powers upon M-Day. Shortly thereafter, Arcade, who had been hired by the Purifiers, began his campaign to destroy District X and all the former mutants within it. Nathan climbed to the roof of his apartment building and saw the laser grid around the district Arcade used to prevent anyone from entering or leaving, reminding him of his days in the concentration camp. Nathan was escorted to an ambulance by Multiple Man of X-Factor, whom he bonded with during the rescue. Unfortunately, Nathan's lungs failed en route to the hospital, and he died, greatly upsetting Madrox.

nathan price.name: Nathan Price
nathan price.first_appearance: Spider-Man and His Amazing Friends Season 3 7
nathan price.origin: The entity that became known as Cyberiad was originally an ordinary male human by the name of Nathan Price. He became a noted physicist that worked in the West Coast in the America. Several years ago, he met a young mutant woman named Firestar, when she was in college. The two fell in love. She quickly served as his assistant, whilst he began work on a study in fusing matter with anti-matter. The two seemed to lead a very happy relationship. Unfortunately; Nathan Price's work attracted the attention of Advanced Idea Mechanics (A.I.M.) who sent agents to murder Price and steal his research for the organization. Whilst wearing a special suit to protect him during an experiment, his laboratory came under attack. The agents quickly attacked Firestar and the stunned Nathan, and also began to destroy Price's valuable equipment as they tried to kill Firestar. The damage resulted in an overload that brought about an explosion on the machine Price was working on just before the attack. Despite their surprise attack, Firestar was able to defeat them. When Firestar came to help Nathan, she discovered half of his body scorched black with anti-matter from the explosion. The incident had also resulted in an imbalance in his mind which made him believe that Firestar caused the accident that ravaged his body. He asked her why she had betrayed him and hurt him, but despite her pleas of innocence and attempt to explain to him what had happened, the now disfigured and heartbroken Nathan Price pushed her away and called her a traitor. Escaping from her grasp, he quickly managed to escape the laboratory, and she lost track of him. Firestar never saw him again and the accident as well as the loss of her love resulted in the incident being repressed by her mind. Nathan in the mean time managed to escape into hiding and plotted his revenge against Firestar. To accomplish this goal, he created a cybernetic body that replaced the scorched half of his damaged form by fusing it to his undamaged half with his knowledge of matter and anti-matter. Programming it himself and calling himself Cyberiad, he plotted to find a way to get his vengeance against Firestar for destroying his research and disfiguring him. Years later, Cyberiad made his move against Firestar and discovered that she was staying at Professor X's mansion with the X-Men. Arriving in a special craft, he snuck into the mansion where he overridden the sensor lock control and managed to take control of Cerebro. Once in command, he turned the Danger Room against the occupants who realized that their home had been infiltrated. It was then Cyberiad revealed himself and when Professor X demanded to know who he was, he simply revealed his name and that one of them knew his origins as well as stated that all of them would suffer because of that person. When Professor X attempted to find him telepathically, he learnt that he was mentally shielded but determined he was in the sub-basement which meant that they had to navigate the locked down mansion. Professor X later learnt the origins of Cyberiad by probing Firestar's mind and unlocked the suppressed memory of Nathan Price. Eavesdropping on the conversation, Cyberiad stated that the traps of the mansion that he managed to easily circumvent were going to be turned against them. He had also captured Nightcrawler with a plasma bubble who attempted to teleport into the sub-basement and turn off the defenses. His cybernetic components came to the conclusion that Nightcrawler was the jouster of the X-Men and created an holographic duplicate of him in order to lead his friends to their doom. When Nightcrawler pleaded for Cyberiad to stop this plan and his inhuman creation, the persona of Nathan Price suddenly resurfaced; Having heard Firestar's confession that she was in fact not responsible for the incident that had ruined his life, Price then wished to abort his plan and attempted to stop Cyberiad, leading to a short struggle, but the machine persona was too strong and continued on its objective of revenge. Due to Cyberiad's tampering of Cerebro, an overload was brought about in the power core of the X-Mansion resulting an explosion within two hours. Using Cerebro, he determined each X-Man's fears and used them against them such as using vibranium to nullify Shadowcat's phasing ability and using adamantium to redirect Colossus's blow back at him thus returning him to his human form. Despite his plans, he was unable to capture anyone else beyond Colossus, and the X-Men managed to reach closer to their destination. It was then Cyberiad abducted Professor X and forced the X-Men along with Firestar to travel through the Maze of Madness. Learning that Thunderbird had deduced the hologram of Nightcrawler was an imposter due to the lack of a smell of brimstone, Cyberiad then programmed the next hologram duplicate to emit the smell to trick them. nathan summers.name: Nathan Summers
nathan summers.species: Mutant infected with the Techno-Organic Virus and sent to the late 37th-early 39th century to survive, Cyborg
nathan summers.origin: ===Origin=== Cable's destiny was planned before his parents even met. Geneticist Mr. Sinister found that a union between the X-Men Scott Summers (Cyclops) and Jean Grey (Marvel Girl) would produce a powerful genetically superior mutant. Sinister hoped he could control such a mutant and use it to defeat his immortal adversary Apocalypse. Around this time Jean's form and consciousness was replaced by the reckless cosmic Phoenix Force while she healed from radiation poison in a cocoon at the bottom of Jamaica Bay. Sinister created a clone of Jean and named her Madelyne Pryor. Sinister's plan was to produce the child he needed from the union of Madelyne and Scott. Sinister considered his clone a failure until a spark from the Phoenix Force granted Madelyne a life force and some of Jean's memories. Sinister crafted a false background for her and arranged for her to meet Scott as a pilot for Scott's grandparents. Scott was instantly drawn to Madelyne because she strongly resembled his true love, Jean. They quickly married. Madelyne later became pregnant and had a son who she named Nathan Christopher Charles Summers. ===Early Childhood Years=== Baby Nathan's alternate reality teenage half-sister Rachel Summers created a psi-bond with him, while promising to protect him and always be there for him. After losing leadership of the X-Men, Scott retired from the X-Men and together he and Madelyne raised the child in Anchorage, Alaska. Over time Scott and Madelyne's marriage became strained. Madelyne resented the fact that Scott was rarely home and that he continued to miss Jean. Everything worsened when Jean was discovered alive. Scott left little Nathan and Madelyne to reunite with Jean and the other founding members of the X-Men in New York to form a new team called X-Factor. Hearing of Jean's return, Mr. Sinister sent his Marauders to capture Nathan and to kill Madelyne, before she could be exposed as a clone. Madelyne survived and came into the care of the the X-Men, while Sinister took Nathan to his secret lab hidden under the State Home for Foundlings, the orphanage in Nebraska where Nathan's father had grown up. There, Sinister experimented on Nathan. Sinister was thorough and erased all records of Nathan and Madelyne's existence. Scott later returned to Alaska to reconcile with his family, but there was no trace of them except for a baby toy he found left behind in their old home. Scott believed Madelyne had moved away with the baby. While staying with the X-Men, Madelyne learned the reason why Scott had abandoned her and slowly lost herself to the dark side of her personality. Madelyne agreed to help the demons S'ym and N'astirh create a link between demon infested dimension of Limbo and Earth in exchange for baby Nathan. Madelyne became aware of her powers and began calling herself the Goblin Queen. The precognitive mutant Destiny pointed Scott and Jean to Sinister's lab where they found Nathan and many other children in incubation pods. While attempting to rescue Nathan, Scott and Jean battled Nanny and Orphan-Maker, who were attempting to kidnap mutant children to safeguard them. Somehow a telepathic link between Nathan and Jean was opened. Demons escaped with Nathan and he and nine other kidnapped infants were teleported to Times Square. N'astirh, using the babies as the points of an inverted pentagram, tried to keep a portal open, but the portal was closed by the combined efforts of the X-Terminators and the New Mutants. When his father arrived to rescue him, Nathan was taken back to his mother at the orphanage. Mister Sinister had revealed Madelyne's true origins to her. Blaming Scott and Jean for the misery in her life, she intended to use Nathan and the other nine mutant babies atop the Empire State Building as a sacrifice in her effort to reopen another portal. After the defeat of N'astirh, the Goblin Queen locked herself, Nathan, and Jean inside a psionic barrier. Madelyne killed herself and locked Jean into a mental bond, hoping to take her down with her. Jean re-integrated the portions of her life-force that had gone from the Phoenix Force to Madelyne. In doing so, Jean also received Madelyne's memories, including those of raising young Nathan. Nathan was taken to X-Factor's sentient Celestial Ship, where he was cared for by Scott and Jean. Scott decided to take Nathan with him on missions. Nathan's other mutant powers began to manifest, as he could form a protective telekinetic force bubble around himself. The Riders of the Storm kidnapped Nathan and took him to Apocalypse's base on the Blue Area of the Moon. Before Nathan could be rescued by X-Factor, Apocalypse infected him with a Techno-Organic Virus that was rapidly spreading liquid metal and organic steel through his body and, if not stopped, would kill him. Ship created a protective electromagnetic field and merged with Nathan's electrical parts to keep him alive. A visitor from 2,000 years in the future, Sister Askani of the Clan Askani, ap

While attempting to rescue Nathan, Scott and Jean battled Nanny and Orphan-Maker, who were attempting to kidnap mutant children to safeguard them. Somehow a telepathic link between Nathan and Jean was opened. Demons escaped with Nathan and he and nine other kidnapped infants were teleported to Times Square. N'astirh, using the babies as the points of an inverted pentagram, tried to keep a portal open, but the portal was closed by the combined efforts of the X-Terminators and the New Mutants. When his father arrived to rescue him, Nathan was taken back to his mother at the orphanage. Mister Sinister had revealed Madelyne's true origins to her. Blaming Scott and Jean for the misery in her life, she intended to use Nathan and the other nine mutant babies atop the Empire State Building as a sacrifice in her effort to reopen another portal. After the defeat of N'astirh, the Goblin Queen locked herself, Nathan, and Jean inside a psionic barrier. Madelyne killed herself and locked Jean into a mental bond, hoping to take her down with her. Jean re-integrated the portions of her life-force that had gone from the Phoenix Force to Madelyne. In doing so, Jean also received Madelyne's memories, including those of raising young Nathan. Nathan was taken to X-Factor's sentient Celestial Ship, where he was cared for by Scott and Jean. Scott decided to take Nathan with him on missions. Before Nathan could be rescued by X-Factor, Apocalypse infected him with a Techno-Organic Virus that was rapidly spreading liquid metal and organic steel through his body and, if not stopped, would kill him. fields.personality: Cable is extremely pragmatic when trying to achieve his goals. Despite his strong desire to protect the timeline, in part informed by witnessing first-hand what its alteration can bring, he has himself abused time-travel to alter the past, such as when he resurrected his father. As a young man, Cable learned that Scott Summers and Jean Grey were Slym and Redd Dayspring, and as a result has expressed a strong fondness for them. Kid Cable has also shown a willingness to be more lighthearted and friendly than his older self frequently did.
fields.notes: Nathan's intended name was to be "Christopher Charles Summers" in honor of Scott's real father and mentor - Christopher Summers and Charles Xavier. He was addressed as "Christopher" by his father Cyclops and Jean Grey, but Mister Sinister called him "Nathan Christopher Charles Summers". Madelyne later confirmed that she changed his first name to "Nathan", because as a child Cyclops was bullied by a boy named Nate and hated this name ever since. However, the boy was actually Sinister in disguise. It's also likely that name "Nathan" was an implanted suggestion by him. According to he was named "Nathan" after his paternal great-grandfather. However, his paternal great-grandfather's name is Philip, not Nathan. It is actually his second name "Christopher" that was given to him in honor of his relatives, but grandfather, instead of great-grandfather. Stryfe once claimed he raped Aliya posing as Cable and that Tyler was his son, though this is unsubstantiated. His left eye glows as an effect related to his mutant powers; quite possibly as a vestigial offshoot of his father's genes. The same trait is also seen in his uncle, Vulcan and his alternate-reality counterpart, Nathaniel Grey (Earth-295). Throughout his adventures, Cable has endured numerous injuries, each leaving its mark as a scar. In 1367 A.D., during a conflict in Peru, he suffered a pierced rectus femoris. Later, in 1571 A.D., while battling ninjas in Feudal Japan, he disconnected his flexor carpi radialis. Fast-forward to 1998 A.D., during a fight against Stryfe in Chicago, Cable sustained an ion bullet wound to his bicep. In 1889 A.D., while in Whitechapel, London, his ear was severed during an encounter with Jack the Ripper, leaving a prominent scar. During a confrontation with Apocalypse in 1987 A.D. at Bethells Beach, New Zealand, he suffered a deep tissue energy burn to his chest. Rewinding to 9643 B.C., a battle in Eurasia resulted in a fractured hip bone. In 1993 A.D., during a confrontation with Mr. Sinister in New York City, Cable sustained another injury. Finally, in 2243 A.D., while fighting in New London, his Achilles tendon was severed.
fields.trivia: While in , he was able to break the fourth wall as Deadpool, while pretending he didn't. According to Sabretooth, Cable smells like and gunpowder, which he finds pleasant.
fields.species: Mutant infected with the Techno-Organic Virus and sent to the late 37th-early 39th century to survive, Cyborg

nathan summers moira vii 1.origin: ===Year 5=== Cable fought against Sinister's forces alongside the Brotherhood of Arakko in the war between Krakoa and Arakko. He survived the fight, unlike many other Arakki, and Arakko was destroyed. ===Year 10=== Cable joined Storm's Brotherhood of Mutants and started living on Asteroid S. He also bonded with the remains of Xilo the First Defender and gained all of his knowledge. When Mystique revealed that Sinister possessed a machine that resets reality via clones of Moira MacTaggert, the group went to Muir Island to retrieve it, but Mystique betrayed them by impersonating Wiz Kid, backstabbed Storm, and took the engine with her. ===Year 100=== Still fighting alongside Storm and her Brotherhood, and now calling himself X-Man, the merged Cable and Xilo were instrumental in launching an assault on the World Farm, allowing them to steal the Moira Engine and hide it away, preventing the universe from being reset. ===Year 1000=== At some point in the following 900 years, X-Man lost his life in battle against the Orphan-Madrox. He was fondly remembered for his wise counsel by Jon Ironfire.
