necrosis spirit of corruption.name: Necrosis (Spirit of Corruption)
necrosis spirit of corruption.origin: thumb|left|Original form Necrosis was the Spirit of Corruption, the twin entity of Zanavell, the Spirit of Violence. Both were created by Corruption itself. While Corruption cast out Zanavell until a time she found him useful, Necrosis forsook his origins, finding his own purpose in the form of a new master, the demon Belasco of Limbo. In 1654 C.E., Necrosis went to Earth and killed Chief Hellhawk at Belasco's behest as a message for Mephisto to keep his Spirits of Vengeance out of his realm. Centuries later, the Spirit of Corruption's flames somehow spread to Kowalski, turning him into Vengeance. After Mephisto was overthrown by Johnny Blaze, Necrosis stood guard over his master as Lilith tried to convince him to combine their powers to wrestle control of all Hells. When a depowered Daniel Ketch ventured into Limbo seeking the Spirit of Corruption's help in saving Blaze from the corruption building within him, Belasco made him fight to the death with Necrosis, promising him the assistance he wanted if he won. Ketch was no match for Necrosis, but wasn't killed in battle because Belasco beheaded the Spirit of Corruption before the death blow could be delivered. Necrosis was then forced to bond with Ketch, who Belasco planned to turn into his pawn against Blaze. After using the Blight Blade to cleanse Blaze, Ketch (at this point calling himself the Death Rider) helped Mephisto reclaim his throne to prevent Lilith and Belasco from claiming it. Sometime later, Ketch was approached by Dr. Diyu, the lead scientist of a government-backed group called Infernal Labs. She promised to get him rid of the Spirit of Corruption in exchange for his service, to which he agreed. In the following months, Diyu studied Ketch's connection to Necrosis and weaponized him, sending him in various missions throughout the country. Their activities eventually caught the attention of Blaze and his companion Talia Warroad, who proceeded to invade the Infernal Labs' base of operations to rescue Ketch. Dr. Diyu consequently decided to extract the Spirit of Corruption from Ketch's body, intending to use it in her plan to save her brother's soul from Hell. Because Ketch had been together with Necrosis for too long, he began to die after the separation, prompting Blaze to go after Diyu. Blaze was ultimately successful in bringing Necrosis back to Ketch, saving his life. Fearing Necrosis would develop moral qualities because of his bond to Ketch, Corruption decided to separate the two, leading Ketch to turn into a Spirit of Vengeance again. As the time for her return approached, Corruption sent a hostless Necrosis and several hellfire-powered robots to kill Ketch and the other Ghost Riders in New York, as they posed a threat to her plans. Having already been changed by his time with Ketch, Necrosis tried to resist Corruption's command during the fight, but to no avail. He was ultimately cut down by Hellverine and, with his final breath, warned Ketch that Corruption was afraid of him.

ned brooks.name: Ned Brooks
ned brooks.origin: When his friend Roger White invited him to stay with him when his parents left, Ned gladly accepted. Also, since Roger's father had asked to check on a building that used to be part of a factory he owned, they decided to visit the building, but once they climbed to the roof, the door on the roof closed with the keys in the lock inside. Ned tried to take a rope from a flagpole, but fell and broke his arm. Roger then, even though he was scared, since he suffered from vertigo, he took the rope from Ned and lowered himself from the building to call for help for his injured friend.

ned carter.name: Ned Carter
ned carter.origin: Ned Carter, a janitor, dreamed of being able to build a robot that would take his place to sweep the floors, and after fifteen failed attempts with the sixteenth he managed to build a functioning robot but not like he wanted it, then he destroyed it thinking it was another failure surrendering to the evidence and returning to his old job as a janitor not knowing that instead he had involuntarily invented perpetual motion.

ned cecil.name: Ned Cecil
ned cecil.origin: Ned Cecil is one of Victor von Doom's associates at Von Doom Industries and a bank investor. He told Victor to withdraw money since his company's stocks are dropping. Later, he and the rest of the stockholders decides to withdraw from the company altogether when the Fantastic Four were on the news, damaging the reputation of the company. He attempted to takeover the bankrupt Von Doom Industries. At the company parking lot, he told Victor to go back to Latveria or as he calls it the "Old Country". Victor shoots out a bolt of electricity through his chest, killing him.

ned dobbs.name: Ned Dobbs
ned dobbs.origin: The alien criminal Dargin Bokk gathered together a group of 5 inventors to help him create an army of expendable but repairable robots. Mondu was an alien who discovered a way to move a mind into storage. Manjeda was an alien who developed a teleportation system that could replace one person with another. Graczia was an alien who studied telepathy. Ocsh discovered a dimension known as null space. Byron was from Earth and was an expert in robotics. Together being supervised by Bokk's scientist brother Dargin Ryne they created 5 Darkhawk bodies. Mondu, Manjeda, Graczia, Ocsh and Byron stole the 5 Darkhawk bodies to keep them from falling into Bokk's hands. During the mutiny Bokk killed Manjeda and stole her Darkhawk amulet and became Evilhawk. Ocsh was damaged by an explosion when he tried to change back to human form and his mind merged with the space ship they were in. Byron and Mondu used the mental projection aspect of their amulets to beam their consciousnesses to earth where they merged with two participants in the USA who were part of an experiment in testing ESP. Byron's mind merged Ned Dobbs while Mondu's mind merged with John Trevane aka St. Johnny. Together they tried to recreate a sixth Darkhawk amulet to protect them from Evilhawk never suspecting that they were in fact being manipulated by Evilhawk who had been aware of all of this and waiting for someone to unlock the power of the amulet. Using Kig's techno-virus he was able to manipulate Dobbs and St. Johnny into being Darkhawk's protectors while also spying on him. As one of the two inventors of the Darkhawk amulet Ned frequently became involved in Darkhawk's affairs and became an ally even helping him defeat foes such as the Mahari brothers and Overhawk. Ned and Johnny's origin were presumably rendered apocryphal after the revelation that much of Darkhawk's origin was a hallucination due to a sensory overload from his amulet's datasong. Other characters whose fates were also affected by this revelation include Evilhawk, Ocsh, Portal and Overhawk. Chris Powell's amulet was retconned to being eons old and was revealed to be a creation of the Shi'ar and that other wielders of the amulets were members of an ancient order called the Fraternity of Raptors.

ned horrocks.name: Ned Horrocks
ned horrocks.species: Human with potential activated by First Fallen
ned horrocks.origin: Ned grew up with the rest of the Foursaken. He gained his powers whilst entering a rally with Jamie in the desert. There he and the rest of the Foursaken met the First Fallen who activated their mutant powers and choose them to represent earth in his paradise world. During the ceremony conducted by the Foursaken to bring the First Fallen to Earth, Psylocke interrupted the ceremony, causing the First Fallen to appear only partially in the host body chosen for him before being driven off by Psylocke. The host body begged for death to escaped renewed control. Now aware of that the First Fallen was evil, Ned agreed to kill the host body. The Fallen then manifested as human-shaped energy, apparently killing Horrocks.

ned lathrop.name: Ned Lathrop
ned lathrop.origin: Ned Lathrop was a member of Magneto's second Brotherhood of Mutants team. When Magneto abandoned them, Lifter and his allies became a separate group called Mutant Force. They acted as mercenaries working for Mandrill and his Femme Force against the Defenders. After being captured, they were pressed into trying to defeat the Hulk by the government. Sometime later, Mutant Force joined the Secret Empire as thugs, working for Mad-Dog and Professor Power. They battled the Defenders again when they tried to break-up Damian and Patsy's wedding, and later during an attempted missile strike on Russia. Mutant Force later adopted new identities and became members of the Resistants. As Meteorite, Ned and the Resistants openly opposed the Mutant Registration Act through rallies, civil disobedience, and active criminal behavior. The Resistants eventually folded and Mutant Force was reformed in their original identities. Lifter was last seen fighting against the New Warriors but was defeated by the young heroes. Like many other mutants Lifter became a citizen of the mutant nation of Krakoa. When S.W.O.R.D. offered help in the Snarkwar, Lifter and Burner volunteered to have their powers taken by the Snark.

ned nordstrom.name: Ned Nordstrom
ned nordstrom.origin: Ned Nordstrom was a faithful minister and a non-violent man. While driving on the highway by the Pacific coast, Ned had a flat tire, and stopped to have it replaced with another tire. He was sighted by John Walker, who stopped to offer assistance. After the tire was changed, Ned gave the John a program from his church, and asked the U.S. Agent to come and visit him some time because he wanted to help whatever seemed to be bothering the Agent.

ned parker.name: Ned Parker
ned parker.origin: Ned Parker was a journalist who exposed all the scam attempts. When he learned that a hypnotist, Prof. Jiminez, was going to perform a show where he would send his assistant into the past under hypnosis, Ned introduced himself to him and told him that he knew how he would do it and that it was all a scam. Putting himself in the audience, Ned witnessed the test and while Jiminez tried to hypnotize his assistant, it was Ned who was hypnotized and ended up 500 years in the future in the body of one of his descendants, who like him was trying to expose the scammers and was hypnotized by a hypnotist during the show by being sent 500 years into the past. Returning to his body, Ned was confused not knowing who he was, whether himself or his descendant and so desperate he went to Jiminez asking him that he was not a scammer but had to tell him who he really was, but Jimenez thought he was crazy.

ned ralston.name: Ned Ralston
ned ralston.origin: Ned Ralston is a mutant who is shaped like a dragon. He wasn't taking part in the superhero world. Sally Floyd interviewed him for an article about ethnic diversity in Brooklyn. Later, the Decimation took away his ability to control his flight and he crashed on Fifth Avenue in New York, dying in the process. His funeral was observed only by Sally Floyd, two of his relatives, and the pastor. He was later revived by The Five on Krakoa and was seen beside Hope Summers at the site of the newly expanded Resurrection Protocols.

ned tobolowski.name: Ned Tobolowski
ned tobolowski.origin: Ned Tobolowski is a former student of the Empire State University and an old rival of Norman Osborn. He exposed Osborn for cheating in university, costing Osborn his scholarship and nearly getting him expelled. Ned later ran a successful hedge fund for several years before retiring and was now planning on buying a place in Florida to settle down with his wife. After running into Osborn, Osborn got revenge for what Ned did to him in college by using the Carnage symbiote to rip Ned's face off.

ned white.name: Ned White
ned white.origin: The insane criminal known as Blackbeard breaks out of the asylum, vowing revenge against Rod Adams, the wealthy millionaire who was the star witness at the trial that saw him committed. When the story hits the newspaper, Rod gets Ned White as a bodyguard to protect himself. When the Sub-Mariner hears about the story, he decides to go and see if he can aid Adams. When he arrives at Adam's modern home he witnesses as Blackbeard murders Ned White and tries to escape with Rod as his prisoner.

nedra.name: Nedra
nedra.origin: Nedra was the wife of King Brimer and Queen over the Storm Giants. When her husband plotted an attack against Asgard, she summoned the air-spirit Vanna and commanded it to spy on Odin and the Asgardians, knowing that Vanna was the only thing that could get past Heimdall unnoticed. Nedra and her followers were later seen having been deposed by her subjects and captured by the warriors of Asgard after having created an forbidden portal to Midgard.

neena thurman.name: Neena Thurman
neena thurman.origin: ===Early Years=== The woman who would become known as Domino was actually the result of a top-secret government breeding program intended to develop the perfect weapon, the clandestine super-soldier program Project Armageddon. There she was subjected to tests by Dr. Rossini, which included at one point being given a cat she named "Christmas". Domino was the only test subject to survive, but her "luck" power was deemed a failure to meet the project's goals. Domino's biological mother broke her out of the project and left her with Father Rudolpho Boschelli, in the Church of the Sacred Heart in Chicago. Domino eventually escaped from the Church and became a mercenary. Later, while working for the NSA, Domino was assigned to guard the genius Dr. Milo Thurman, whose analytical ability made him too dangerous for the government to let him roam free. Over time, Domino and Thurman fell in love and were married. Thurman had a thing for Dante's "Inferno" and called Dom "Beatrice". The two separated after a raid on the facility by AIM, with Milo believing Domino had been killed during the altercation. ===Six Pack=== Domino later became a member of the mercenary group the Wild Pack, later known as the Six Pack. Six Pack was led by the mutant mercenary Cable and Domino became intimate with him. Wild Pack was mostly contracted to Mr. Tolliver, an arms dealer and used Cable's orbiting space station, Graymalkin, as a means of teleporting, or "body sliding", in and out of situations. On a mission in Afghanistan, Six Pack learned that Stryfe was in charge of Mr. Tolliver's opium routes and they were contracted to take out the Soviet armored carriers that were in this route's way. After a brief battle, Stryfe and A.D.A.M. Unit Zero teleported away. Cable scrapped the mission, much to the distaste of the team. Angry, Mr. Tolliver sent agents to kill Six Pack, but they were defeated. On another mission, Six Pack invaded a Hydra research facility in search of a stolen component. Once inside, Hammer accidentally triggered a fail-safe and Baron von Strucker's image appeared everywhere, threatening to kill Six Pack, but they quickly retrieved the device and body slid out. Six Pack later found-out that they were working for A.I.M.. Feeling used, Six Pack decided to go after Stryfe in Uruguay. After entering an underground bunker, Six Pack battled their way into a control room, where Hammer began to download secret information from Stryfe onto a CD. While waiting for the disk to finish downloading, Stryfe teleported behind Kane and grabbed his neck, demanding Hammer to give him the CD. Before Hammer could give Stryfe the CD, Cable shot him from behind. Stryfe grabbed the disk telekinetically and set-off a self-destruct on the bunker. Cable teleported away, leaving Six Pack to fend for themselves. Domino went on her separate way. thumb|left|Domino escaping Mr. Tolliver ===X-Force=== Sometime later, Mr. Tolliver abducted Domino, replacing her with the shape-shifting mutant Copycat, so as to spy on Cable's activities. Domino was watched-over and abused by Pico Halfghanagan and kept locked away for more than a year, while Copycat lived Domino's life. Arriving at Tolliver's base, Cable shot Pico and found Domino, in chains. After rescuing Domino, the pair battled Deadpool and Tolliver was seemingly killed in a helicopter explosion. As he teleported away, Cable requested Domino track down X-Force. While searching for X-Force, Domino found Copycat and rounded up Grizzly and Hammer, former members of Six Pack. The group found Cable, Kane, and G.W. Bridge, all former members of Six Pack and, after a brief battle, Domino again went her own way. After the loss of several squadmates, Cable asked Domino to join him as part of X-Force. Reluctant to work alongside people who knew Copycat as Domino better than her, Dom ultimately agreed. During her time with the X-Force, Domino came into conflict with Donald Pierce and Lady Deathstrike, who had captured Milo Thurman and were attempting to download his mind to a computer. Dom stopped the process, but it cost Thurman his life. Then, during Operation: Zero Tolerance, Domino was captured by a Prime Sentinel named Ekaterina Gryaznova. Domino had seriously injured Gryaznova three years previously while rescuing Dr. Rebecca Schuyler, when the robot Gryaznova had been piloting through a long distance cybernetic link was destroyed. As revenge for these acts, Gryaznova had Domino implanted with a neural blocker that interfered with her synaptic relays, effectively shorting out her power and her coordination. The experience left Domino shaken, and as a result, she chose to leave X-Force, believing she could be of no use to the team in her current condition. However, Dom was still very dangerous, proving it to herself by stopping a bank robbery single-handedly, which brought her to the attention of a federal agent. She also collaborated with Interpol to help take down a known criminal who was employing the servi

fields.notes: Domino's real name was eventually revealed as Neena Thurman. For a long time, she was called "Beatrice," a name that was a play on her luck powers, as Beatrice is derived from 'beatus,' the Latin word for 'lucky.'
fields.trivia: If Domino was on a desert island, the piece of music she would pick would be Never Mind the Bollocks by the Sex Pistols. Following the tragic death of her husband, Dr. Milo Thurman, Neena went into deep isolation in a Portland safehouse, where she met Teylor Flores—a Hispanic therapist and aspiring model. Because of Flores' gentle, patient listening skills, Neena fell into what she internally regarded as the most emotionally grounding romance of her life. Unlike her turbulent, adrenaline-fueled relationships with Cable or Colossus, Domino's bond with Flores was entirely domestic and secure; she famously learned to cook traditional Hispanic dishes for him and completely avoided using weapons or mercenary gear in his presence to preserve his peaceful lifestyle. However, after a vengeful mercenary ambush severely injured Flores, Domino realized her probability-altering "luck" field brought dangerous cosmic rebound backfires to civilians who stayed near her. In her most devastating act of devotion, she vanished overnight without a trace, sacrificing her deepest shot at true happiness solely to keep Flores safe from her lethal world.

nefer neith sinue.name: Nefer Neith Sinué
nefer neith sinue.origin: Nefer Neith Sinué is a paradox. Implied to be a native of the Negative Zone, she and everyone else on her planet were put in suspended animation to wait out an ecological catastrophe. While they waited, Sinué and her associate, Jomo Kimayne, were appointed as guardians of the system, as Rosetta Stone and Lockdown. To keep the subjects sane, they were put in a VR program and allowed to socially interact within their roles. Nefer's role was to live a double life: dilettante heiress by day, caped vigilante by night. The program was stable, until a group of new arrivals - the Fantastic Four - managed the impossible and escaped the system by sheer force of will. Pulled out of VR by an emergency program, Lockdown and Rosetta Stone vowed to track down the interlopers to keep their city safe. They showed up again during a "contest of champions", having apparently tracked the Fantastic Four to Earth. However, at no point in the encounter did they meet their quarry, and they apparently left soon after having helped the heroes.

nefertiti.name: Nefertiti
nefertiti.origin: Nefertiti was a queen of the 18th Dynasty of Ancient Egypt and the wife of Pharaoh Akhenaten. They were known for a religious revolution, in which they worshipped one god only, Aten. She reigned as Pharaoh after her husband's death and before the ascension of her son Tutankhamun. ===Legacy=== The King Cycle gang broke into a museum and stole Nefertiti's necklace. A statue of Nefertiti is kept at the Metropolitan Museum of Art.

negative forbush man.name: Negative Forbush-Man
negative forbush man.species: The living embodiment of Forbush-Man's internal rage
negative forbush man.origin: Negative Forbush-Man was the embodiment of Forbush-Man's internal rage, caused by his inability to become part of the real Marvel Universe. Prior to his first confrontation with Forbush-Man, he spent time searching for him. After coming into possession of the Infinity Wart, a magical wart that brings the possessor's desires into being, intentional or not, Irving used it become ruler of the world. It was then that Negative Forbush-Man appeared, saying he was never meant to get the Infinity Wart and it was rightfully his. He kidnapped Irving and steals the Infinity Wart. Negative Forbush-Man began experimenting with his new power when Milk and Cookies attacked. He used his abilities to bring out their dark sides in the shape of Bread and Water. The four did battle, but eventually, Milk and Cookies succeeded. Negative Forbush-Man used the Infinity Wart to collapse all of space and time, crushing Milk and Cookies under every character in the Marble Universe. However, Milk and Cookies escaped to the Aniverse, home of Spider-Ham. From a secret lair, Negative Forbush-Man sent Pork Grind to do battle with the heroes. He watched the fight unfold from a hidden camera as the real Forbush-Man attempted to break free. After Pork Grind was defeated, Wolverina appeared suddenly, destroying the hidden camera and rallying the heroes to go after Negative Forbush-Man. The heroes ambushed Negative Forbush-Man and freed Irving. Negative Forbush-Man gained the upper hand and attempted to kill Irving. Wolverina used her claws to cut the Wart off of Negative Forbush-Man's finger. In his panic, Negative Forbush-Man lost the pot he used as a mask and disappeared in a flash of light. Milk asked if they killed him, but Wolverina reassured her that Negative Forbush-Man was a spoof of a Starlin character, and they never really die. Surviving, he tried again on Earth-41940. Negative Forbush-Man recruited this world's Pork Grind to act as the evil doppelgänger of Pork's Spider-Ham. He figured a crooked double would lead to an easy victory, but Negative Forbush-Man's plans were foiled by Spider-Man.

negus.name: Negus
negus.origin: King Negus was an early king of Wakanda who prioritized art and music, carrying a Talking Drum everywhere he went; Wakandan culture flourished under his rule. It was during this rule that some jambazi first discovered the alien Resurrection Altar's ability to revive the dead; however, through study of his talking drum and the relationship between Vibranium and sound, Negus was able to discover an energy frequency that cancelled out the Altar's energies, which came to be called the Negus Cadence. When Negus didn't invite the Jabari to the Taifa Ngao, they kidnapped him, forcing Negus' daughter Turkana to assume the throne in his absence. After months of standoff, Turkana went to the Jabari-Lands and personally negotiated her father's release. Among all the former Black Panthers who gave T'Challa counsel as the King of Necropolis, Negus was the oldest.

neil armstrong.name: Neil Armstrong
neil armstrong.origin: Neil Armstrong is a famous test pilot and astronaut. He was the first man to ever walk on the Moon as a result of the Apollo 11 space mission on July 16, 1969. He was unaware that his mission was jeopardized by the Skrulls, aliens trying to undermine the space program on Earth as part of a future invasion. This plot was thwarted by the First Line a group of American super-heroes who were active in the late 20th century.

neil donaldson.name: Neil Donaldson
neil donaldson.species: Mutant depowered by Forge's power neutralizer
neil donaldson.origin: An unsuccessful sculptor, Neil Donaldson's mutant powers developed relatively late in life. When he found he had the power to disintegrate matter that he touched, however, he turned to crime as an industrial saboteur called the Termite to help raise money to further his artistic ambitions. He was soon hired by industrialist Obadiah Stane to destroy the factory of a rival electronics company. However, the factory's owner alerted his friend Clytemnestra Erwin, who in turn informed her friend James Rhodes, who at the time was acting as the hero Iron Man. Iron Man opposed the Termite, and Termite, not wishing to battle the hero, fled the scene by tunneling away. Later, Rhodes as Iron Man investigated the tunnels under the factory and found the Termite, with whom he started fighting. Rhodes was forced to stop the fight when the factory began to collapse and he had to save its owner. Iron Man continued the pursuit, but lost the Termite again until he turned up at an art gallery and created a sculpture, hoping for acclaim. When one of the gallery's visitors criticized his sculpture, however, Termite ran amok. Rhodes arrived, having seen Termite on television, and he fought the villain. As the battle continued, Rhodes' employer and predecessor as Iron Man, Tony Stark arrived with the mutant power neutralizer designed by Forge and shot Termite with it, removing his powers. The depowered Termite was taken into police custody and jailed. Stane decided to have Termite killed rather than be implicated in his crimes, so he hired the assassin the Enforcer to kill him. However, before the Enforcer could carry out the hit, he himself was killed instead by a disguised Scourge of the Underworld. So, ironically, the superhuman criminal-killing Scourge saved the Termite's life. The Termite was later seen in prison bemoaning his capture and ruined life.

neil farr.name: Neil Farr
neil farr.origin: After it was published that Dr. Neil Farr had made a new discovery worth millions of dollars, three thugs decided to rob him of his discovery, so they broke into Dr. Farr's house and seeing that he was manipulating a strange box, convinced that inside was the discovery, under the threat of weapons they made him hand it over even though Dr. Farr insisted that there was nothing in the box and in exchange they made him give them a jar with pills that Dr. Farr said he needed. Convinced that the pills were for his health and fearing that if he died they would not know how to open the box, reluctantly they gave them to him. They then tried several attempts to open the box but without success, until they were reached by two police detectives who arrested the three criminals. After the arrest however they wanted to know what was inside the box and Dr. Farr reiterated that there was nothing inside but the box itself was made of a new super resistant metal of his invention while his millionaire invention were the pills he ingested that were able to communicate telepathically and that was how he had communicated to Detective Boyd of their position.

neil langram.name: Neil Langram
neil langram.origin: Neil Langram was a Canadian government agent, and his partner in the agency was the man called Logan. He was also a mutant, and had resolved to come out as one to the agency when he was killed by an unseen assassin, a killing which was linked by Logan and American agent Carol Danvers to a string of murders centered around a book entitled The Shadow Society, which sought to expose mutants to the public. The book's author and two of Logan and Langram's superiors at the agency were also killed before the murderer was finally captured.

neil mackenzie.name: Neil MacKenzie
neil mackenzie.origin: Dr. Neil MacKenzie, a professor in the Physics Department of Thames University, was also Brian Braddock's tutor and friend. He lived in Seraph Mews, where he rented a flat out to Brian. Dr. MacKenzie defended Captain Britain against Chief Inspector Thomas' accusations of having deliberately provoked Hurricane's attack against the Thames University. Dr. MacKenzie further accused the Chief Inspector of persecuting the wrong man for the crime. Sometime later, Dr. MacKenzie accidentally heard Brian inside his room, knocking unconscious his brother Jamie to prevent him from involving himself in the search for another costumed criminal. Talking through the door, MacKenzie accepted Brian's excuse that he'd simply knocked over a stack of books and continued on his way.

neiro aratabi.name: Neiro Aratabi
neiro aratabi.origin: Born in Kumagaya City, Neiro Aratabi was praised for her beauty as a child - though those same people often disparaged her mother as being hideous and joked that she should commit suicide. Despite this, Neiro's mother said that she was proud of her daughter and grateful that her unattractive appearance made Neiro that much more adorable by comparison. At some point Neiro was scouted by one of Japan's premier talent agencies and by the age of sixteen she became a popular idol singer. At some point, while hiking through a forest she discovered an amnesiac symbiote she nicknamed Kage and became its host, though to her annoyance it took to eating fans who threatened her. While at a handshake event after a performance, Neiro was attacked by a deranged fan with a knife, who declared his intent to kill her and then himself. Kage promptly devoured the man, and Neiro hid her face from her fans until the symbiote retracted into her body. fields.personality: Maintaining the image of a pure and innocent idol to appeal to her fans, Neiro Aratabi is actually obsessed with fame and goes to extreme lengths to maintain this veneer around others. However, she possesses a ruthless and cruel side, telling her symbiote Kage that she couldn't care less how many people it ate or who they were so long as none of them were her fans. Her subservience to her fandom is such that she frequently scolds Kage for using lethal force to protect her from deranged fans attempting to kill her, immediately dropped her guard around Loki Laufeyson when he lied that he was one of her fans, and told Deadpool she would forgive someone for wanting to rape her simply because he was her fan. Neiro also possesses a deep sense of melancholy regarding her mother, who was cruelly mocked and castigated for her unattractive appearance when Neiro was a child but told Neiro that she was nevertheless proud of her daughter. She is also observant, as she was able to accurately recognize Deadpool's behavior as a coping mechanism to distract himself from negativity, and empathizes with him due to her experience as an idol.

fields.trivia: The Kage symbiote extending its head from Neiro's back to converse with her is seemingly based on Eddie Brock and the Venom symbiote from the 2018 Venom movie. When fully transformed, Neiro resembles the 2018 Venom with a set of pigtail-like tentacles extending from the sides of her head, something that Deadpool makes note of during their battle in and . Neiro was originally going to have a larger role in the manga, but this was vetoed due to the editors not liking her.

nekra sinclair.name: Nekra Sinclair
nekra sinclair.origin: ===Origin=== Decades ago, Gemma Sinclair was an African-American cleaning lady at Los Alamos National Laboratory. While she was pregnant, an exploding lab experiment bombarded Gemma with radiation, causing her unborn child to mutate. Nekra was born albino-like with vampiric features. Loathed by her parents and community, Nekra ran away into the New Mexico desert to live alone when she was fourteen years old. ===Mandrill=== She soon encountered another child who had been mutated by the same explosion. Although his parents were white, he had been born dark-skinned and had developed fur and baboon-like features, for which he had named himself Mandrill. For six years they lived by theft and scavenging, until they were attacked by a lynch mob that thought they were monsters. While filled with rage, Nekra discovered she was invulnerable to the mob's attacks. Slaying a few of their persecutors, the two escaped and come to regard each other as if they were siblings. The two later left to Africa, as part of the Mandrill's ambitious scheme to overthrow multiple nations through Black Spectre, a cult of personality powered by the Mandrill's pheromonal control over women. This effort was thwarted by Shanna the She-Devil. The two eventually escaped, kidnapping Shanna's father in the process, and eventually killing him. Their next plot was of similar means, whereby they used the Mandrill's powers to raise a cult of black women to overthrow America. They were eventually defeated on the White House lawn by Daredevil, the Black Widow, and Shanna. Abandoned by Mandrill, Nekra was captured by authorities. ===Cult of Kali & the West Coast=== Nekra was held captive and drugged in a S.H.I.E.L.D. hospital, until a subliminal message from Hate-Monger inadvertently gave her the rage necessary to break free. While in the New York sewers, Nekra encountered the Cult of Kali, whom she persuaded that Nekra herself was the reincarnation of Kali. She then moved to the West Coast where she killed and replaced Adrienne Hatros, the reclusive sponsor of an emotional research clinic where Nekra hoped to overcome her own dependency upon emotions. This plot was foiled by the first Spider Woman. Sometime later, Locksmith began kidnaping and imprisoning superhumans, whom he mostly found by tracking Spider-Woman and capturing superhumans she interacted with. This included Nekra. Other prisoners included Shroud, Tigra, Werewolf by Night, Poltergeist, Angar the Screamer, Daddy Longlegs, Dansen Macabre, Hangman, Killer Shrike, Needle, Gypsy Moth, Tatterdemalion, Enforcer, and Flying Tiger. When Locksmith finally captured Spider-Woman herself, she defeated Locksmith and freed the prisoners she trusted. Nekra (and the other criminal prisoners) were turned over to the police. ===Grim Reaper=== Escaping again, Nekra fell in with the voodoo-master the Black Talon as a voodoo tutor, and with the Grim Reaper as her lover. When the Grim Reaper died in combat, Nekra was able to briefly reanimate him as a zombie, so lifelike that even the Grim Reaper did not realize he was dead. When Nekra's love became greater than her hate though, the Reaper died again. Nekra took his corpse with her, in hopes of reanimating him again. Nekra then had run-ins with Spider-Man, Hank Pym, and Alpha Flight. Nekra finally managed to re-animate the Grim Reaper again, but this time there was a caveat: he had to kill one person every 24 hours in order to stay 'alive.' The Reaper then promptly chose Nekra as his first victim and killed her. ===Hellstorm's Agent=== Sensing the potential threat of Doctor Druid, Daimon Hellstrom used his magics to reanimate Nekra, and sent her to investigate him. First she seduced Dr. Druid, then shot him in the forehead, killing him. ===The Loners=== Nekra was donating genetic material to an M.G.H ring that had sprung up in L.A. after the death of The Pride. She was defeated by Ricochet, Darkhawk, and the third Spider-Woman. She later returned to the Loners' meeting place to get her revenge on them. Nekra easily defeated all of the Loners in battle and preceded to strangle Mickey, when she was struck from behind by a mysterious lady named "Namie". ===San Francisco & Utopia=== During the riots in San Francisco, Nekra was seen fighting alongside Frenzy. She was taken out with a sucker punch energy blast by Ms. Marvel of the Dark Avengers. When the mutants fought the Avengers on Utopia, Nekra, Frenzy, and Bling! took down Ms. Marvel. Nekra reunited with the Grim Reaper as a member of the Lethal Legion as part of a failed scheme against Norman Osborn. ===Chaos War=== Nekra assisted a resurrected Grim Reaper in fighting the Dead Avengers. nell ruggles.name: Nell Ruggles
nell ruggles.species: Human Mutated by emanation from lunar object of unknown origin
nell ruggles.origin: A troubled young girl in Eberhardt, Nebraska, Nell Ruggles hoped not to be remembered as the quiet girl who killed her classmates. However, she acquired superhuman powers which can eventually be traced back to a device which the Icarus One astronauts brought back from the Moon. Using her powers to attack local students who had bullied her in the past. Running away from home, she was captured by the Blur and turned over to Nick Fury's SHIELD organization. Thanks to an electroshock collar, she has been prevented from leaving, though she appears to be making the best of the situation, having made friends and eventually falling in love with Tucker Ford (aka Biogeneral) whom she would go on to marry after being depowered.

nels van adder.name: Nels van Adder
nels van adder.species: Human mutate; first subject to take the Goblin Formula
nels van adder.origin: Nels van Adder was a research assistant to Norman Osborn on "Biogenetic Project Supreme," which presumably aimed to test and perfect what would one day be known as the "Goblin Formula." He accepted to be used as a guinea pig to test the formula before they had a stabilizing reagent. As a result, Nels horribly mutated into a red creature. Following his transmutation, he was spotted lurking around the gates outside the Osborn Plant by the police, who were hunting a serial killer at the time, and was stopped for questioning. Losing control over himself, Nels attacked the officers and ran into the plant, where he was eventually surrounded by police captain George Stacy, Osborn's newly appointed head of security Arthur Stacy, and a team of security guards. After attacking a guard and being shot by George, Nels escaped from the facility. In the next day, Nels confronted Norman in the old laboratory of Mendel Stromm, from who Norman had stolen the formula used on Nels. He blamed his boss for his predicament, but was soon reminded by him that he had volunteered for that. A short time after letting Norman collect a sample of blood, Nels ended up losing control again and attacked his employer. The Stacy brothers arrived just in time to save Norman's life, throwing Nels out of a window into a river nearby. Nels survived and moved into an abandoned apartment complex, where he lived in squalor with dummies modeled after his wife, Olivia, and their children, Lucas and Hope. He was found by Emily Osborn, who hired him to kidnap her son, Harry in exchange for an antidote to the Goblin formula. Nels's first attempt to do so was thwarted by the rookie superhero Spider-Man. He made a second attempt, directly confronting Norman and his personal security, and this time successfully abducting Harry. He brought the unconscious Osborn to a cabin in the woods where Emily awaited them. Before she could give him the antidote, Emily gave Nels another task, that being killing Norman. He managed to break inside the hospital Norman was recovering and prepared to end the life of the man who ruined his, but was unable to bring himself to do it. Norman soon woke up and mocked Nels over his predicament, enraging the Proto-Goblin which prompted him to reveal that his former wife Emily had sent him. This shocked Norman, while Spider-Man arrived to battle the monster. The two fought, but during the fight, Nels' body began melting due to the formula, forcing him to flee. He attempted to make his way back to the cabin, only for Spider-Man to keep following him. In the woods he noticed Emily fleeing from the cabin in her car, and went to crush it, demanding that give him the antidote now. To his dismay, Emily told him that she had lied and never had an antidote for his condition, devastating Nels. Spider-Man came to her rescue, and again fought Nels. Nels retreated one last time, but eventually his body gave in and fell apart, and in his death he found peace at last.

nelson frank.name: Nelson Frank
nelson frank.origin: Nelson Frank discovered an unmarked sack in a men's restroom at Shea Stadium, along with titanium gloves and the skeleton of a horned creature. He took the items home, where the sack released creatures from another dimension that killed his mother. Using the gloves, Nelson forced the creatures back into the sack and later used them to kill several people. Adopting the identity of “the Sack, he attempted to rob a Brooklyn bank but was stopped by Deadpool, who caused the sack to fall and then pulled it over Nelson's head, seemingly allowing the creatures to consume him. The sack's current whereabouts are unknown.

nelson gruber.name: Nelson Gruber
nelson gruber.origin: Nelson Gruber was a student at Metropolitan University. He was conducting sleep experiments as part of his studies. One of his experiment's patients, Rick Sheridan, demonstrated unusual brain patterns. Gruber was curious about the patterns and amplified them. The computer he was using exploded from the energy and knocked Gruber unconscious. The energies Gruber was infected with were from the Mindscape, which had been released from Sheridan as the host of Sleepwalker. When Gruber woke up, he discovered that his mind was able to generate representations of any written material. Adopting the identity of Bookworm, the unhinged Gruber decided to take revenge on his perceived "enemies". Sleepwalker sensed the energies of the Mindscape and discovered Gruber torturing Whitney Cooper, a student he felt had wronged him. With the assistance of Sheridan's girlfriend, Alyssa Conover, Sleepwalker was able to defeat Bookworm. Bookworm was taken into custody and imprisoned with the strict rule that he have no contact with written materials. Years later, Gruber would reemerge outside of the prison system and no longer using the Bookworm name, began to instead use his powers to capture beings and locations from his favorite pieces of fiction, creating a kingdom he intended to lord over as king. Gruber underestimated his subjects and was cast out by character The Wicked Witch, who was able to magically remove his right hand and bind it to his copy of the book, allowing her to maintain control over Oz in Gruber's place. Feeling like he had nowhere else to turn, he found himself before the Last Door, leading him to Wanda Maximoff to beg for her help. Wanda was able to see through Gruber's attempts to present his rule as magnanimous but nonetheless agreed to assist. Pretending to have captured the escaped Gruber to return him to Oz for his punishment, Wanda dueled and defeated the Wicked Witch, claiming the book and Gruber's hand for her own, before using her own magic to seal the characters back where they belonged and freeing them from both Gruber and the Witch's rule. Rather than take him in for his crimes once again, Wanda decided to leave Nelson Gruber to his own fate - stranding him inside of Oz, still missing his hand and with no way to access the book itself, forced to face the justice of the characters he had attempted to enslave. Gruber ended up in Empire City, where he came under the protection of Bishop Slaughter, the villain protagonist of The Blood Bandit. Wanting revenge on the real world, Bookworm used his powers to summon people who read The Blood Bandit into the Ideaverse, where Slaughter would force them into becoming one of his Bloodletters, eventually gaining enough recruits to take over the Ideaverse and the real world. Due to being bound by a magical uroath to whoever ruled the throne of Oz, the Sorcerer Supreme of the Ideaverse, Prospero, was prevented from interfering with Gruber's actions. When Edwin Jarvis was pulled into the Ideaverse, Hawkeye, Daredevil, and Shang-Chi of the Avengers Emergency Response Squad followed to rescue him. Jarvis managed to escape Slaughter but the three Avengers allowed themselves to be captured. When the Avengers managed to break free to rescue Slaughter's prisoners from his hideout, Bookworm tried to flee but was confronted by Jarvis. Jarvis knocked out one of Gruber's teeth with one of the Ten Rings and left him at the mercy of the Avenging Literary Society. Bookworm initially insulted them for being fictional characters but then tried to offer them rewards if they let him to, to which they refused. As a last ditch effort to keep the Avengers and his prisoners trapped in the Ideaverse, Slaughter killed Gruber with his cleaver. However, this broke the uroath that bound Prospero, who used his magic to pacify Slaughter and send the displaced prisoners Bookworm had captured back to their reality.

Due to being bound by a magical uroath to whoever ruled the throne of Oz, the Sorcerer Supreme of the Ideaverse, Prospero, was prevented from interfering with Gruber's actions. When Edwin Jarvis was pulled into the Ideaverse, Hawkeye, Daredevil, and Shang-Chi of the Avengers Emergency Response Squad followed to rescue him. Jarvis managed to escape Slaughter but the three Avengers allowed themselves to be captured. When the Avengers managed to break free to rescue Slaughter's prisoners from his hideout, Bookworm tried to flee but was confronted by Jarvis. Jarvis knocked out one of Gruber's teeth with one of the Ten Rings and left him at the mercy of the Avenging Literary Society. Bookworm initially insulted them for being fictional characters but then tried to offer them rewards if they let him to, to which they refused. As a last ditch effort to keep the Avengers and his prisoners trapped in the Ideaverse, Slaughter killed Gruber with his cleaver. However, this broke the uroath that bound Prospero, who used his magic to pacify Slaughter and send the displaced prisoners Bookworm had captured back to their reality.
powers: Gruber was able to manifest physical representations of any written material.
abilities: Gifted psychology student
weaknesses: Only able to use his powers when in physical contact with written material.

nelson kohler.name: Nelson Kohler
nelson kohler.species: Killed during the White Event, Nelson Kohler's spirit was altered, forever to be pulled to various events
nelson kohler.origin: Nelson Kohler was like every other human on the day the White Event occured. Blinded by the light while driving, Nelson wrecked his car. While his life was hanging in the balance, his wife opted to have his life-support pulled. When Nelson died, only his body ceased to function - his spirit became something more, altered by the White Event. Taking on the form of a Noir-styled detective, Nelson soon found himself being pulled towards certain people, watching their powers manifest. Horrified at what he had saw, he attempted to ascend on, but found that his spirit would not rest. Overcome with despair, he found himself encountering the Anti-Body of Randy O'Brien. He lashed out at the creature, hoping it could make himself die. Instead, he overpowered it, consequently worrying that he had killed it, and realizing that he could take over O'Brien's body. When the Anti-Body truly began to die, Nelson relented and released his hold on O'Brien. The event changed him, making him realize that he may be fated to be a mere witness towards all. On December 22, 1987, Nelson would find himself pulled by something dark and twisted. Rushing to the source, he found Ken Connell soaring over Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, attempting to pass the Star Brand onto a barbell. Despite his best efforts, Nelson failed and Ken attempted to pass it, which resulted in Ken destroying Pittsburgh in the process. Nelson attempted to follow Ken, but opted to investigate the results instead. Unable to cope with the tragedy, Nelson hallucinated finding Pittsburgh, only to have the citizens there attack him. Attempting to flee, Nelson finally regained his senses, realizing that he had gone mad from what he had witnessed. After evading the view of Jenny Swensen's MAX Armor, Nelson made a vow - he would make Ken Connell pay for the destruction of Pittsburgh. He would ultimately succeed in this goal. Taking the form of one of Ken's friends, he haunted a powerless Ken, causing him to drive off a cliff. He would appear one last time, convincing Jacob Bumley, the latest wielder of the Star Brand, that resurrecting Pittsburgh was impossible.

nelson mandela.name: Nelson Mandela
nelson mandela.origin: ===Militant=== Nelson Mandela was a leader of the up-rising against the , racial laws against coloured people in South Africa. He was eventually captured by the South African Security Forces, after they had been tipped by the C.I.A.. During this period, the African National Congress, Mandela's party, was strongly supported by T'Chaka, monarch of Wakanda. thumb|left|220px|Congratulating T'Challa (Earth-616)|T'Challa ===President and retirement=== The apartheid was eventually abolished and full voting rights were established in 1994. Mandela became the first President of South Africa after the abolishment of Apartheid. On T'Challa's coronation, Nelson Mandela was among the nations' leaders to congratulate him, along President George H. W. Bush, Fidel Castro and Prince Namor. At some time, he visited The Black Captain America, Isaiah Bradley, even if his role was unknown to most people and was kept secret by the U.S. government. Nelson Mandela attended to the wedding of Storm and Black Panther, again along Castro, and Bush's son, President George W. Bush.

nelson stone.name: Nelson Stone
nelson stone.origin: Stone, Wade and Briggs' FBI superior, debriefed Briggs on her encounter with the Scarlet Spider imposter. He ordered Briggs to forget about the Scarlet Spider, and continue investigating the technology recovered from Lady Octopus' base and the disappearance of Wade. Unbeknownst to Briggs, Stone harbored suspicions that Wade was the Scarlet Spider. After reading Briggs' personal files, Stone briefed a group of agents about the Scarlet Spider situation, and on the possibility of Wade being alive. He assigned Briggs to stake out Wade's house. Stone took agents Torrez and Morrison down to the site of the battle between the New Warriors, Spider-Man, and the Scarlet Spider, and ordered every other available FBI agent there, except for Briggs, who came anyway. After Briggs talked Wade down, Stone took him into custody and stonewalled Spider-Man, who wanted an explanation.

nelvanna.name: Nelvanna
nelvanna.origin: ====Third Host==== In 1000 AD, the Third Host of the Celestials occurred, during which the aliens informed they would return 1,000 years later to judge Earth's right to continue existing. While the pantheons prepared for war, Gaea planned a peaceful solution to the problem with many goddesses, among them Nelvanna. For the next thousand years, they searched for humans representing mankind's highest ideals, to be offered to the Celestials as an offering. The goddesses placed the candidates in suspended animation, with their superhuman potential, the legacy of the First Host, awakened. ===Narya=== Nelvanna, Goddess of the Northern Skies, left the mortal plane of existence with the other Inuit Gods generations past. However, the Northern Gods sensed that their ancient foes, the Great Beasts, would one day break through their dimensional prison and return to threaten humankind. To guard against this, the Inua wished to produce a champion, a demi-goddess child born of both man and god, belonging to both worlds. Nelvanna appeared before the Canadian man named Richard Easton in a vision along with her father Hodiak and the Shaper. They explained their plans to him, and asked Easton to mate with Nelvanna. Easton initially opposed the idea due to Nelvanna great physical age, but the Shaper cast his magicks to make Nelvanna appear as a beautiful young woman. Easton spent one night in the realm of the gods with Nelvanna, although he returned to find considerably greater time had passed on Earth, driving him to madness. When Nelvanna was ready to give birth to her child, the Sarcee medicine man Michael Twoyoungman was midwife to the birth. The child, Narya, was born in the Canadian North and magically bound to the Earthly plane by Twoyoungman's magic, making her a changeling with both human and divine aspects. ===Chaos War=== left|thumb|Snowbird, Nelvanna, Kadlu & Tekkeitsertok vs. Mikaboshi’s enslaved alien gods When the Shinto god of evil Mikaboshi and his army of enslaved extraterrestrial deities invaded Quidlivun, realm of the Northern Gods, Nelvanna defended against the attack alongside Kadlu, Snowbird, and Tekkeitsertok. However, when Kadlu realized they could not win the battle, she and Nelvanna decided that Snowbird (whose half-human physiology allowed her to travel between dimensions easier) should retreat to the Earth dimension to regroup. Nelvanna created a portal to Earth and pushed Snowbird through it against her will, just before Mikaboshi dealt a fatal attack to Nelvanna.

nemain.name: Nemain
nemain.origin: ===Origins=== Nemain was a Celtic goddess and a member of the Tuatha de Danaan. Presumably born in Tír na nÓg, the Otherworld, she was revered as a war goddess. Alongside Badb and Macha, she is recognized as part of the Triple Goddess of Celtica. ===Hyborian Age=== During the Hyborian Age, approximately 10,000 BC, Nemain was one of the many deities worshiped in Hyboria. She was also known as Nemain the Venomous. While Crom was the chief god of Cimmeria, and Morrigan was subordinate to Crom, Nemain, along with Badb and Macha, was subordinate to Morrigan. She was notably invoked by the Cimmerians, often alongside Macha. ===Celt Worship=== Although a distinct entity from Morrigan, Nemain became conflated with Morrigan over time. Her place among the Celtic triple war goddesses, alongside Morrigan and Macha, often alternated between her and Badb in various traditions. ===Modern Age=== In modern times, Doctor Druid sought power from Nemain, Badb, and Macha. The goddesses granted him new abilities, but the process drove him mad. They encouraged him to partake in grotesque rituals, including consuming the remains of sacrifices offered to them. Druid attempted to reshape Earth according to the will of the Celtic gods but was ultimately killed by Nekra.

nenora.origin: Nenora was a Skrull who had infiltrated the upper ranks of the Kree military and she was locked into her Kree form after the bomb that locked the Skrulls' shapeshifting powers. She worked for Kylor one of the 5 claimants to the Skrull throne after the destruction of Throneworld by Galactus. Nenora became the ruler of the Kree Empire when the Silver Surfer stole the Soul Gem from the Supreme Intelligence which drove him mad as he had been using it to offset the racial prejudice between the pink and blue Kree brains that comprised his mind. Nenora killed Kylor and anyone who knew she was really a Skrull. Later the Cotati shared the truth about Nenora with Shalla-Bal. Nenora had Shalla-Bal kidnapped and drugged to keep the truth from coming out. When S'Byll, another claimant to the Skrull throne, discovered the secret, she gave Nenora her shape-shifting powers back, which killed her via shock. thumb|left|150px|Revealed as a Skrull

neoptolemus.name: Neoptolemus
neoptolemus.species: Human son of Achilles and grandson of Thetis
neoptolemus.origin: ===Origin=== Achilles was the seventh son of Peleus, one of the greatest of Achaean warriors, and of the sea goddess Thetis (who had been forced by Zeus to marry Peleus after she avoided union with him). During the Trojan War, while searching for Troy and after sacking Teuthrania (mistaking it for Troy), Achilles put in at Scyros (where he had lived hidden for some time), where he married Deïdameia, the daughter of King Lycomedes. During the wedding, Teuthrania king Telephus came to him, as Achilles was the only one who could heal his wound, by scraping rust from the ashen spear that had wounded Telephus into the wound. In gratitude, Telephus showed Achilles the way to Troy. Achilles impregnated Deïdameia before leaving. His son Neoptolemus, thanks to the fact his father was the son of a goddess, Thetis, grew up quickly. In about nine years, he looked as old as his own father. ===Trojan War involvement=== ====Eurypylus==== As the oracle and Priam's son Helenus foretold that without the son of Achaea's most formidable warrior (among other things), the war would never end, Odysseus and Diomedes went to Scyros to retrieve Neoptolemus. He was given from Odysseus (who had been granted them after Achilles' death) his father's ashen spear, armor, shield and sword, forged by Hephaestus. nephri.name: Nephri
nephri.origin: Nephri was Apocalypse's first love, but after rejecting him many times due to her superstitious beliefs, she asked her guards to kill him for his appearance. Later, when he saved her from death, he rejected her in turn. After fifty years, at her deathbed, he came back and mocked her for losing her beauty, and that her end came closer every moment. He on the other hand was left unchanged, and once her memory was gone from the world he he planned to look at it and laugh.

nephrus.name: Nephrus
nephrus.origin: Nephrus was the royal wizard of Egyptian Pharaoh Aram-Set circa 1,000 BCE. Aram-Set's reign ended when a Swarlili slave named N'Kantu led a bloody revolt which ended with the Pharaoh dangling on the edge of his spear. As he raided the Pharaoh's temple, he came upon the wizard Nephrus. Nephrus was prepared for the warrior-slave's treachery and splashed him with a chemical agent that caused immediate paralysis of N'Kantu's limbs. He brought him down to a private dungeon laboratory where he bound him with linen and injected him with a special fluid. This fluid granted N'Kantu immortality, but at the price of his mobility. Nephrus sealed him inside of a sarcophagus, promising that he would suffer as a Living Mummy for all eternity. Moments after entombing N'Kantu, a great earthquake struck and devastated the temple, killing Nephrus and burying N'Kantu for centuries. Trapped and unable to move, N'Kantu gradually went insane as the centuries slowly passed. Nephrus' spirit languished in the underworld for centuries. During this time, N'Kantu rose from his tomb and wandered the Earth as a living mummy. Years passed, and N'Kantu eventually acquired the Orb of Ra. Using the Orb, he summoned the spirit of Nephrus and begged him to release him from this hellish existence. Nephrus however, had never anticipated a need to reverse the serum's effect and was unable to provide the Living Mummy a peaceful death.

nephut sha.name: Nephut-Sha
nephut sha.origin: When Pharaoh Ramses was killed chasing Moses through the parted Red Sea, the sorcerer Nephut-Sha sacrificed many people to Seth in his bid for revenge against the freed slaves. Seth transformed Nephut-Sha into the two demons Gog and Magog. However, when they began attacking the people of Egypt, Merenptah and his men fought back and imprisoned the demons in two tombs for all eternity.

neptunia.name: Neptunia
neptunia.origin: ===Origins=== Neptunia was the daughter of Olympian god Neptune. ===20th Century=== In the 1950s, Neptunia came to believe that her father was killed during the nuclear bomb tests conducted by the United States on Bikini and Eniwetok, and she began crafting a plan to avenger her father's death. To this end, she took to calling herself Neptunia and developed the mortal guise of Diana Seacrest. She founded Seacrest Realty Company and by 1951, she was selling affordable seaside homes along the Atlantic coast, particularly to retired soldiers. When her development was sold out, she summoned a massive tidal wave to wipe it out, killing everyone living there. The freak occurrence prompted the Federal Housing Association to investigate the disaster and although they found no wrong doing, they called Seacrest to their offices in Washington, D.C. There Seacrest was informed that the FHA did not want her to continue building houses along the coast for the sake of public safety and that they were pulling all of her government grants. Furious Seacrest refused to stop developing the area, the move gained a lot of press attention. The headlines grabbed the attention of of Beauty Magazine owner Whitney Hammond assigned his editor Venus (unknown to Hammond she was really the Olympian love goddess Aphrodite) to investigate Seacrest. To this end, Venus purchased a home in one of Seacrest's newest developments. Shortly thereafter, Neptunia called upon another storm to wipe out the development that Venus bought into. Seeing Neptunia in the waves, Venus thought she was a drowning woman and came to her rescue just moments before a massive tidal wave wiped out the development. Realizing that the woman in the water was Seacrest, Venus tried to capture her, but Neptunia vanished in the waves. Unaware of her godly heritage, Venus assumed that she had drowned. The next morning she was shocked to find Seacrest alive and well at her companies head office. When Venus questioned her about her involvement in the accident, Seacrest ejected her from her offices. Venus became suspicious of Seacrest and convinced the company that insured her developments to stop paying out to her for the accidents and then had the last of her developments evacuated by the military. Neptunia resurfaced once more and attempted to wipe out the development anyway and was confronted by Venus once again. Both revealed to each other their godly heritages and Venus learned Neptunia's motivation in causing the disasters. During their struggle, Neptunia was swept up in a whirlpool and vanished, destroyed by her own plot.

nereel.name: Nereel
nereel.origin: Nereel is a member of the Fall People of the Savage Land. When the X-Men were visiting the Savage Land after escaping from Magneto's Antarctic lair, Colossus saved Nereel and a female friend of hers from a T-Rex that was attacking them. Nereel became especially fond of Colossus, and the two girls took the X-Man off for a romantic rendez-vous, claiming that it was part of a Tribal custom to honor their friend that had not survived the dinosaur attack. Some time later, the X-Men (including Colossus) revisited the Savage Land when it and its people were apparently destroyed by the scavenger Terminus. However, Nereel and a number of other Savage Land natives had been saved by the other-dimensional ruler M'Rin. Colossus was reunited with Nereel, who now had a son named Peter. Colossus is Peter's father, though Colossus was not told this. Longshot knew the truth about Peter's parentage and nearly revealed it to Colossus, but Nereel prevented him from doing so. When the Savage Land was rejuvenated, Nereel and the other survivors resettled there, and Nereel took up her late father's mantle as chief of the remaining Savage Landers.

nergal.name: Nergal
nergal.origin: ===Origin and Early Years=== Nergal was the son of Dagon and Ninlil. ===Irkalla=== Nergal rarely stayed in Irkalla and often ventured on Earth to spawn war and blood lust. He led both mortals and gods against their enemies, and often tried to seize power from Marduk. The Sebettu (or Isirru in Babylon), a group of seven gods, often followed him into battle, spreading famine, drought and pestilence among their enemies to prevent survivors. He was possibly part of the group as well. ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== Before Kull's reign over Valusia circa 18,500 BC, a mystic relic he had empowered, the Hand of Nergal, fell to Earth. Other recountings state that the talisman could be Nergal's real hand, and that its fall on Earth occurred during the Hyborian era. His rival Tammuz empowered a counter-talisman known as the Heart of Tammuz to oppose it. The Hand was used by many dark sorcerers, including Xaltotun of Acheron around 13,000 BC, and was always by the Heart of Tammuz. ===Hyborian Age=== Circa 10,000 BC, when Conan and his friends brought the Heart of Tammuz side by side with the Hand of Nergal, the brutal, hulking, misshapen shadowy form of Nergal, more like to some stupendous ape than a man, appeared from the magical talisman and began fighting its counterpart. Although it seemed to be winning, Nergal eventually dissolved before the vengeful embrace of all-pervading brightness. left|thumb ===Modern Era=== In the modern era, Nergal is considered a Demon and was married to the demoness Allatou. Under his alias Mot, he served Death in her plan to shape the Thing into her new consort. After the Thing broke up with his girlfriend Alicia Masters, Mot aided in keeping Alicia trapped in an unspecified Hell Dimension while Death attempted to seduce the Thing on Earth masquerading as choreographer Amaryllis Dejure. However, after the Thing discovered Death's plan, he transported to the Hell Dimension where he defeated Mot in combat on his way to rescue Alicia.

neri asgardian.name: Neri (Asgardian)
neri asgardian.origin: Neri was the hand-maid to Frigga. Once, as Neri sought passage across Asgard's Bifrost Bridge, she was stopped by Heimdall, the bridge's guardian, who was checking everybody who could possibly be Loki, the god of mischief, hidden by a magical disguise. Neri pointed out to Heimdall that Loki was still chained to a boulder which was visible from their position. Satisfied that Neri's response, Heimdall allowed her to cross the Rainbow Bridge.

neron alak.name: Neron-Alak
neron alak.origin: Neron-Alak is a member of an unknown alien race. Untold eons ago he travelled to Earth for unspecified purposes. Two thousand years ago he appears to have been regarded as some sort of king or perhaps even god in ancient Egypt, as they had built him his own temple called 'The Tomb of Neron-Alak.' The tomb was rumored to hold untold treasures, but also came with a great curse. Supposedly anyone who opened the tomb would unleash a terrible danger upon the world. One greedy, egotistical archeologist failed to heed these warnings, too obsessed with dreams of fame and grandeur. He found entrance into the temple despite the warnings of the locals. When inside, he found his treasure but became lost inside the labrynith of the tomb. Then, what the scientist believed to be a statue of Neron-Alak began to move. The creature thanked the man for awaking him from his slumber of millenia and proceeded to leave, wishing to secure relics of Earth (rare treasures on his world), to return to his distant planet.

nessus.name: Nessus
nessus.origin: Nessus was a centaur of Greek Legend. He was born to Centarus and to a Magnesian mare. He worked as a ferryman for the River Evenus. He kidnapped Hercules' second wife Deianira, whereupon Hercules shot him with an arrow. Feigning a wish to make amends, the dying centaur told Deianeira how to make a love charm from his allegedly enchanted blood, aware that it was now tainted with the lethal poison of the Hydra, in which Hercules had dipped his arrows. When Deianeira rubbed the supposed love charm into Hercules' shirt, she inadvertently caused Hercules' mortal demise, granting Nessus his late revenge.

nettle.name: Nettle
nettle.origin: The Warpie known as Nettle gained her powers when he was effected by a reality warp created by Mad Jim Jaspers when he attempted to take over Great Britain. Somehow, Peeping Tom was not discovered by the agents of the R.C.X. and needed to be "rescued" from her family. However, Nettle probably unconsciously heard the call of Siren and sought her out only to be discovered by Uncle Lex and became a member of the "Parasites". All of the Parasites were trained by Uncle Lex to use their powers to become petty thieves and to obey him blindly, which the children did without question. Since Uncle Lex didn't value the children under his care, he taught them to not really care about each other as well. thumb|left|260px When her fellow Parasites, Peeping Tom and Spasm found the Cherubim nearby and brought them to their home, the Den, Nettle aided them and helped them to settle in. network nina.name: Network Nina
network nina.first_appearance: Nick Fury, Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. Vol 3 2
network nina.origin: ===Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D.=== Network Nina was a cyber-psionic whose abilities were engineered by S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Esper Division. She developed telepathic abilities from the program, but was also rendered somewhat unstable. Nina was discharged from the program and ended up running a bar in the Florida Keys after the Deltite affair. When the Gnobian Death's Head Commandos began striking at former S.H.I.E.L.D. agents, Nick Fury recruited Nina back into active duty. Nina was a regular asset to S.H.I.E.L.D. as they reformed under the purview of the United Nations. ===Battle with X-Force=== Nina could scan for hostile forces, so Nick Fury assigned her for an infiltration mission into Graymalkin. Unfortunately, aboard the space station, she learned that the E-M burst which decloaked the base was also screening her telepathy, so she couldn't scan anyone, and her whole team got eventually defeated by the X-Force. When War Machine confronted the X-Force and the battle got too destructive, Professor announced to everyone on board that emergency measures were being taken and a destruct sequence had begun. While Network Nina and the other S.H.I.E.L.D. operatives were deciding what they would do and if they should leave before the ship broke apart or if they should try to salvage what they could, the Professor announced an alert and the ship exploded. Network Nina and the other S.H.I.E.L.D. agents, as well as the rest of X-Force, were then teleported aboard the Sternberg by Lila Cheney. ===Battle with Psi-Borg=== When Nick Fury suspected G.W. Bridge had been forced to act against his will, he had Network Nina scan Bridge's mind. Nina detected signs of intrusion, and they tracked the culprit back to Psi-Borg, a S.H.I.E.L.D. Super-Agent who was secretly a Hydra infiltrator. Nina nearly killed herself exerting her cyber-psionic implants against Psi-Borg in psychic combat. She eventually recovered and was seen at the funeral service for Kate Neville.

Terrified, Neuron attempted to cause him more pain, but discovered Wolverine has lost all sense in his rage, leaving him to die at Wolverine's hands.

neutron.name: Neutron
neutron.origin: Neutron was a member of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard. He was a traitor who served Lord Samédàr, Deathbird, and the Brood in their conspiracy to overthrow Shi'ar Princess-Majestrix Lilandra. While Neutron was pardoned alongside the rest of the Imperial Guard traitors, and returned to service under the crown, his family was less forgiving- cutting off all contact and making it clear he would never be allowed to return home. With nowhere to go back to, Neutron pledged himself to his work. Neutron later battled Quasar (Wendell Vaughn) during the Kree/Shi'ar War. Following the defeat the Shi'ar Empire by the Inhuman-led Kree following the War of Kings, Neutron was among the Imperial Guard tasked with subjugating worlds rioting against Shi'ar control. When Izumbard declared its independence from the Empire, Neutron was part of the assault force- his quantum body nullifying the rebels attempts to shoot him down. Despite his defenses, Neutron was too slow to save his fellow Guardsman, Voltar from the explosion that killed him. Later he was part of an Imperial Guard force sent to explore the Fault. Coming in contact with escapees from the Cancerverse, including that reality's X-Men, Neutron was killed saving fellow Guardsman Fang. He was later memorialized alongside other fallen Guard members.

She was the regular girl of William "Billy-Blue" Vickers who attempted to get her to leave the city with him when the Legion of the Damned was set to turn him into a vampire. She declined and Billy-Blue was killed by the Legion shortly after. Neve then turned to Blade to look into the matter. Blade who was raised by Madame Vanity after his mother's passing agreed and sought out the Legion at their hideout. After having barely escaped the Legion, Blade returned to the brothel where soon after the Legion attacked and killed Neve along with Madame Vanity and the other girls.

never open.name: Never-Open
never open.origin: "Never-Open" was one of the archetypal beings from the Fourth Cosmos who formed the templates of heroes and villains seen in future iterations of the Multiverse, notably the Seventh/Eighth Cosmos. When the Fourth Cosmos was visited by Carlo Zota, he stole Never-Open's mask which prevented him from seeing. He was seen by the Defenders on the edge of the battlefield between the forces of Of-Past and Of-Future. Following the Fourth Cosmos' end, the archetypes joined with the Sentience of the Fourth Cosmos, later known as the Queen of Nevers, in exploring the Mystery.

newton destine.name: Newton Destine
newton destine.origin: Newton Destine was born in 1774. During his long life, he has used is intuitive genius to benefit himself and protect his family. Predicting the advancements of humankind, Newton developed the Relative Strangers Protocols to protect the secret identities of his family allow them to begin new lives with minimal suspicion. As part of the Relative Strangers Protocols, Newton, posing as his uncle, acted as the guardian and mentored his younger brother, Dominic. The pair still maintain their close relationship. Knowing that Dom was always been rather wild, Newton gave Dom a Signal Watch to summon him and placed a 4-D tag on him that allowed him to track Dom throughout the Multiverse. Newton was a contemporary of Albert Einstein, Einstein admired Newton's brilliance. Trying to protect Vincent from the immense and dark nature of his powers, and Adam Destine consulted with both Newton and Einstein. In 1969, Newton attended Woodstock with his brothers Will, Dominic, Sebastian, Maurice Fortuit, and Vincent using Adam's VW van. Newton primarily resides on Ethera, an alternate reality Earth, where he is known as the Warlord of Ethera. On Ethera, Newton received a second, larger, more muscular body, and can switch between both bodies at will. Additionally, Newton is currently dating the beautiful Satyr-Nun. However, Satyr-Nun often becomes annoyed with being ignored by Newton and frequently playfully destroys his inventions to get his attention. When summoned by Dominic Destine's Signal Watch, Newton can quickly teleport back to Earth when needed. Recently Newton has brought Dominic to recover on Ethera in order for him to find a calmer environment to survive in. However, when Vincent's spirit returned to Earth, Dominic and Newton both returned to try to save him.

nexxx.name: Nexxx
nexxx.origin: During the Hyborian Age, Nexxx was a dark, angry, and baleful god who lived in his dark dimension. His existence was known only to a few, including his servants, the Witches of Nexxx, though Jonnwalli invoked his name in an exclamation. He developed an alliance with the Elder God Set. At the spot where they met in Stygia, a temple was built, and Liirix was its caretaker, serving both Nexxx and Set. On a night when Nexxx could pierce the barriers between his and Earth dimensions, the Witches of Nexxx brought him two brides, with whom he laid, giving birth months later to two sons, Jonnwalli and Dukenrik. The two babes were given to Okniragg the Brythunian, a minor sorcerer indebted to Nexxx, for him to raise them. The boys were supposed to have their father's blood awaking in them.
